literature.headline_zh: 乙型肝炎病毒本期文献呈现多方向研究进展
literature.lead_zh: 本期乙型肝炎病毒研究集中呈现以下进展。
key_findings_zh: 乙型肝炎总体知晓率较高(95.5%),平均知识得分为12.37 ± 1.42。74.2%的受访者表现出良好的知识,而57.2%的受访者对乙肝预防表现出良好的态度。疫苗接种 的吸收率很高,93.5% 的人报告至少接受了一剂 疫苗,但只有 22.3% 的人完成了推荐的三剂时间表。 [10.1186/s40794-026-00311-5]
RT 区域的 突变 率从 ASC 到 HCC 逐渐增加(趋势 P < 0.05)。Logistic 回归确定 rtS106A/C 与 ALD 显着相关,而多变量分析证实 rtH55R/Q/K 和 rtS137T/Q/E 是 HBV 相关 HCC 的独立危险因素。 [10.1007/s11262-026-02261-8]
三组的基因型和等位基因分布存在显着差异(p < 0.001),其中 HCC 组具有更多的 T 等位基因。TT 基因型患者患 HCC 的风险较高(AOR = 4.26;95% CI = 1.89-9.62;p < 0.001),尤其是肝硬化、血清 HBV DNA 水平高和 HBeAg 阴性的患者。 [10.1155/ijh/6122232]
考虑到抗体滴度为 10 mIU/mL 就足够了,糖尿病患者的无保护率为 54.3%(95% CI:45.3%-63.2%),非糖尿病患者的无保护率为 28.2%(95% CI:20.5%-37.0%)。性别、血糖控制和病程超过1年没有显着影响。 [10.1002/hsr2.72700]

总体确认的 HBV 阳性率(每 100,000 名捐献者)为 288.5,HCV 为 16.2,HIV 为 14.8。HBV 和 HCV 呈显着下降趋势(p < 0.01),而 HIV 则显​​着上升(p < 0.01)。HBV、HCV 和 HIV 的累计 NAT 产量分别为每百万份献血 189.35、2.94 和 2.15。2015 年至 2023 年间,乙肝病毒(634.79 至 238.34)和丙肝病毒(1.69 至 0.99)的每百万次捐赠的估计总体 RR 有所下降,但艾滋病病毒的估计总体 RR 有所上升(4.08 至 11.40)。 [10.1111/vox.70324]
literature.trend_or_risk_zh: 本期研究方向以入选文献实际覆盖的临床、流行病学、宿主生态、诊断或分子监测主题为准。
literature.lead_en: This reporting window highlights the following research developments.
key_findings_en: Overall awareness of HBV was high (95.5%), with a mean knowledge score of 12.37 ± 1.42. Good knowledge was observed in 74.2% of respondents, while 57.2% demonstrated good attitudes toward HBV prevention. [10.1186/s40794-026-00311-5]

The mutation rate in the RT region increased progressively from ASC to HCC (P for trend < 0.05). Logistic regression identified rtS106A/C as significantly associated with ALD, while multivariate analysis confirmed rtH55R/Q/K and rtS137T/Q/E as independent risk factors for HBV-related HCC. [10.1007/s11262-026-02261-8]

Of the 407 participants, 114 (28%) had good knowledge, 170 (41.8%) had positive attitudes, and 156 (38.3%) demonstrated safe practices toward HBV; key predictors of good knowledge included older age (AOR 3.81, 95% CI 2.09–6.94) and higher education (AOR 3.05, 95% CI 1.80–5.16). [10.1002/hsr2.72869]
The three groups had significantly different genotype and allele distributions (p < 0.001), with the HCC group having more T alleles. [10.1155/ijh/6122232]

Considering an antibody titer of 10 mIU/mL as adequate, the non-protection rate was 54.3% (95% CI: 45.3%-63.2%) in diabetic individuals and 28.2% (95% CI:20.5%-37.0%) in non-diabetics. Sex, glycemic control, and disease duration over 1 year had no significant effect. [10.1002/hsr2.72700]

news.headline_zh: 乙型肝炎病毒本期公共卫生新闻动态
news.lead_zh: 本期乙型肝炎病毒新闻集中呈现以下动态。
key_findings_zh: 巴西正在寻求泛美卫生组织 (PAHO) 确认消除 传播 (HBV) 母婴 传播。据报道,该请求是一项公共卫生倡议,但证据中缺乏具体的确认细节。 [news-c87a5ab5982cc717]
据 Wits 大学报道,AGTRU 的四位年轻科学家正在开发用于 乙型肝炎病毒 (HBV) 治疗 和预防的下一代技术,包括新型 疫苗 和基因疗法。 [news-4df0b1c320b23792]
替诺福韦艾拉酚胺(TAF,Vemlidy)已在加拿大省级和联邦处方集上以 乙型肝炎病毒 治疗 上市。这是一项已确认的政策变化。 [news-ea24929fa5a5c323]
葛兰素史克 (GSK) 资助的一项调查发现,公众对 慢性乙型肝炎 (CHB) 的了解有限,许多人不知道其癌症风险,也没有考虑进行检测。本文讨论了提高初级保健机构检测率的策略。 [news-d0dc2f95095e4e5a]

讨论贝匹罗韦森,一种研究中的反义寡核苷酸,定位为 慢性乙型肝炎 (CHB) 的潜在 功能性治愈。肝病专家(Nancy Reau,医学博士;Tatyana Kushner,医学博士;Kimberly Brown,医学博士)权衡了初级保健与专门中心以提供此 治疗。GSK 报告称,在 B-Well 1 和 B-Well 2 试验中,贝匹罗韦森接受者的 功能性治愈 汇总率为 19%,而基线乙型肝炎表面抗原水平为 1000 IU/mL 或更低的亚组中,这一比例为 26%。 [news-88c3e7a776ff935b]
news.trend_or_risk_zh: 风险判断仅依据入选来源已经确认的信息，不把媒体推测升级为官方结论。
news.lead_en: This reporting window highlights the following Hepatitis B virus news developments.
key_findings_en: Brazil is seeking validation of the elimination of mother-to-child transmission of hepatitis B virus (HBV) from the Pan American Health Organization (PAHO). The request is reported as a public health initiative but lacks specific confirmation details in the evidence. [news-c87a5ab5982cc717]

Four young scientists at AGTRU are developing next-generation technologies for hepatitis B virus (HBV) treatment and prevention, including novel vaccines and gene therapies, as reported by Wits University. [news-4df0b1c320b23792]
Tenofovir alafenamide (TAF, Vemlidy) has been listed for hepatitis B virus treatment on provincial and federal formularies in Canada. This is a confirmed policy change. [news-ea24929fa5a5c323]

A survey funded by GSK found that public understanding of chronic hepatitis B (CHB) is limited, with many individuals unaware of the cancer risk and not considering testing. The article discusses strategies to improve testing rates in primary care settings. [news-d0dc2f95095e4e5a]

Discussion of bepirovirsen, an investigational antisense oligonucleotide positioned as a potential functional cure for chronic hepatitis B (CHB). Expert hepatologists (Nancy Reau, MD; Tatyana Kushner, MD; Kimberly Brown, MD) weighed primary care against specialized centers for delivering this treatment. [news-88c3e7a776ff935b]

news.en: This reporting window highlights the following Hepatitis B virus news developments. Brazil is seeking validation of the elimination of mother-to-child transmission of hepatitis B virus (HBV) from the Pan American Health Organization (PAHO). Four young scientists at AGTRU are developing next-generation technologies for hepatitis B virus (HBV) treatment and prevention, including novel vaccines and gene therapies, as reported by Wits University. papers.title: Risk of Virological Failure After Switch to a Tenofovir-Sparing Dual Therapy in Virologically Suppressed People With HIV and Past HBV Infection.
papers.abstract: We compared the effectiveness of tenofovir (TFV)-based triple regimens (TT) to TFV-sparing dual therapies (DT) in virologically suppressed, HBsAg-/HBcAb+ people living with HIV (PLWH). We emulated a target trial including adults PLWH from five University Hospitals, with HBsAg-/HBcAb+ serostatus, starting a TT with unsuppressed serum HIV-RNA and reaching HIV-RNA 50 cp/mL or a single HIV-RNA ≥ 200 cp/mL) were estimated through a weighted Kaplan-Meier estimator. Overall, 415 PLWH were eligible for study analysis: 71 (17.1%) started a DT (3TC-based: 78.9%) during follow-up. They were mainly men (329, 79.3%), with a median age of 48 years. In the weighted analysis, the estimated probabilities of VF were: 29.3% for DT and 29.9% for TT at 5 years (difference: 0.5%; 95% CI: -28.7, +21.6). A higher VF risk was seen in the subset of PLWH with undetectable HBsAb at the longest follow-up available (4 years), independently of treatment group: 15.5% and 36.8% with DT and TT, respectively (difference: -21.3%; 95% CI: -30.3, -13.8). Switch to a TFV-sparing DT, compared with continuing a TT, was not associated with an increased risk of VF in PLWH and prior HBV infection.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to compare the effectiveness of tenofovir-based triple regimens to tenofovir-sparing dual therapies in virologically suppressed people living with HIV and past hepatitis B infection.
analysis.study_design_and_population: This was an emulation of a target trial including adults with HIV and HBsAg-/HBcAb+ serostatus from five University Hospitals, comparing tenofovir-based triple regimens to tenofovir-sparing dual therapies.
analysis.methods: The study estimated the probability of virological failure (defined as HIV-RNA > 50 cp/mL or a single HIV-RNA ≥ 200 cp/mL) through a weighted Kaplan-Meier estimator.
analysis.main_results: In the weighted analysis, the estimated probabilities of virological failure were 29.3% for dual therapy and 29.9% for triple therapy at 5 years (difference: 0.5%; 95% CI: -28.7, +21.6).
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpreted that switching to a tenofovir-sparing dual therapy was not associated with an increased risk of virological failure compared to continuing a triple therapy in this population.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings support the use of tenofovir-sparing dual therapies as a viable option for virologically suppressed people with HIV and past HBV infection, potentially reducing long-term tenofovir exposure.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study was an emulation of a target trial, which may introduce unmeasured confounding; however, the large sample size and robust statistical methods provide moderate confidence in the results.

analysis.summary_en: This study compared tenofovir-based triple regimens to tenofovir-sparing dual therapies in virologically suppressed people living with HIV and past hepatitis B infection. Among 415 eligible participants, 71 started dual therapy during follow-up. The estimated 5-year probability of virological failure was similar between groups (29.3% for dual therapy vs. 29.9% for triple therapy). A higher virological failure risk was observed in participants with undetectable HBsAb at longest follow-up, but this was independent of treatment group. The findings suggest that switching to tenofovir-sparing dual therapy is not associated with increased virological failure risk in this population.

papers.title: Self-reported hepatitis B vaccination uptake and associated factors among adults in a tertiary hospital, Nasarawa State, Nigeria.
papers.abstract: Background Hepatitis B virus (HBV) infection remains a major public health challenge in sub-Saharan Africa despite the availability of a safe and effective vaccine. In Nigeria, adult vaccination coverage and completion rates are not well characterized within hospital-based populations. Methods A hospital-based cross-sectional study was conducted among 1,200 adults attending Federal Medical Centre (FMC) Keffi, Nasarawa State, Nigeria. Data on socio-demographics, HBV-related knowledge, attitudes, perceived barriers, vaccination uptake, and completion were collected using a structured questionnaire. Knowledge and attitude scores were categorized into poor, fair, and good levels. Associations between socio-demographic characteristics and vaccination uptake were examined using chi-square and Fisher's exact tests, with statistical significance set at p Results The mean age of respondents was predominantly 36-40 years (32.5%), with males constituting 72.3%. Most respondents had tertiary education (91.8%) and were civil servants (83.4%). Overall awareness of HBV was high (95.5%), with a mean knowledge score of 12.37 ± 1.42. Good knowledge was observed in 74.2% of respondents, while 57.2% demonstrated good attitudes toward HBV prevention. Vaccination uptake was high, with 93.5% reporting receipt of at least one vaccine dose. However, only 22.3% had completed the recommended three-dose schedule, while 48.2% and 23.1% had received one and two doses, respectively. Willingness to complete vaccination was reported by 81.6% of respondents. Perceived barriers included high vaccine cost (72.4%), inadequate access to health facilities (96.9%), fear of side effects (71.9%), and insufficient information (73.5%). No significant associations were found between socio-demographic variables and vaccination uptake (p > 0.05 for all). Conclusion Despite high HBV vaccination initiation and knowledge levels, substantial gaps in vaccine completion persist. Addressing financial, informational, and access-related barriers is essential to improve full vaccination coverage among Nigerian adults.
papers.journal: Tropical diseases, travel medicine and vaccines

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 尽管有安全有效的 疫苗,乙型肝炎病毒 (HBV) 感染仍然是撒哈拉以南非洲地区的一个主要公共卫生挑战。在尼日利亚,成人 疫苗接种 的覆盖率和完成率在医院人群中没有得到很好的描述。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 对尼日利亚纳萨拉瓦州凯菲联邦医疗中心 (FMC) 的 1,200 名成年人进行了一项以医院为基础的横断面研究。受访者的平均年龄主要为36-40岁(32.5%),其中男性占72.3%,大多数受过高等教育(91.8%),并且是公务员(83.4%)。
elements_zh.methods: 使用结构化调查问卷收集有关社会人口统计学、乙型肝炎相关知识、态度、感知障碍、疫苗接种 摄取和完成情况的数据。知识和态度得分分为差、一般和良好三个级别。使用卡方和 Fisher 精确检验检验社会人口特征与 疫苗接种 吸收之间的关联,统计显着性设置为 p < 0.05。
elements_zh.main_results: 乙型肝炎总体知晓率较高(95.5%),平均知识得分为12.37 ± 1.42。74.2%的受访者表现出良好的知识,而57.2%的受访者对乙肝预防表现出良好的态度。疫苗接种 的吸收率很高,93.5% 的人报告至少接受了一剂 疫苗,但只有 22.3% 的人完成了推荐的三剂时间表。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 尽管 HBV 疫苗接种 启动和知识水平较高,但 疫苗 完成方面仍然存在巨大差距。该研究强调,81.6% 的受访者表示愿意完成 疫苗接种,这表明如果障碍得到解决,就有可能取得进步。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 解决财务、信息和获取相关障碍对于提高尼日利亚成年人的 疫苗接种 全面覆盖至关重要。这些发现可以为有针对性的干预措施提供信息,以提高医院环境中 HBV 疫苗接种 的完成率。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究是在一家三级医院进行的,这可能会限制对其他人群或环境的推广。尽管样本量很大,但由于横截面设计和潜在的自我报告偏差,证据强度适中。

papers.title: Trends in Hepatitis B, Hepatitis C, and HIV Seroprevalence in the Netherlands: Insights From Two Decades of Nationwide PIENTER Serosurveys.
papers.abstract: Hepatitis B (HBV), hepatitis C (HCV), and HIV remain public health challenges despite effective treatments and preventive options. Infections are often asymptomatic, leading to undiagnosed cases, onward transmission, and preventable morbidity and mortality. In the Netherlands, disease burden is concentrated in specific populations, with many undetected infections. We estimated HBV, HCV, and HIV seroprevalence, identified determinants, and assessed trends over 20 years using data from 14,444 participants aged 15-79 years from three nationwide cross-sectional serosurveys (PIENTER: 1995-1996, 2006-2007, and 2016-2017). Participants completed questionnaires on demographics, behaviour, and socio-economic factors, and serum samples were tested for HBV and HCV in all rounds and HIV in 2017. Seroprevalence estimates were weighted to the Dutch population, trends were analysed using weighted Poisson regression, and determinants were evaluated using multivariable Poisson regression. Weighted HBV seroprevalence remained stable across surveys (3%-5% past or present infection; < 0.4% active infection). HBV prevalence was highest among first-generation migrants, with older age, migration background, and STI history as key determinants. HCV seroprevalence remained low (< 0.4%) and was highest among non-Western migrants. HIV prevalence was 0.1% and highest among non-Western migrants and men who have sex with men. Only 9% of active HBV cases were aware of their status. Overall, HBV, HCV, and HIV seroprevalence remain low in the Netherlands but are concentrated in specific groups with limited awareness. These findings support targeted prevention, screening, and linkage-to-care strategies to achieve the 2030 WHO elimination goals and highlight the importance of continued population-based (sero-)monitoring to guide public health policy.

Fiona R M van der Klis

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 尽管有有效的 治疗 和预防方案,乙型肝炎 (HBV)、丙型肝炎 (HCV) 和 HIV 仍然是公共卫生挑战,感染往往无症状,导致未确诊病例和可预防的发病率和 死亡率。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 我们使用来自荷兰三项全国性横断面血清调查(PIENTER:1995-1996、2006-2007 和 2016-2017)的 14,444 名 15-79 岁参与者的数据估计了 HBV、HCV 和 HIV 血清流行率,确定了决定因素并评估了 20 年来的趋势。
elements_zh.methods: 参与者完成了人口统计、行为和社会经济因素的调查问卷,并在2017年对血清样本进行了各轮乙肝病毒和丙肝病毒检测以及艾滋病毒检测;血清流行率 估计值根据荷兰人口进行加权,使用加权泊松回归分析趋势,并使用多变量泊松回归评估决定因素。
elements_zh.main_results: 加权 HBV 血清流行率 在整个调查中保持稳定(3%-5% 过去或现在的感染;< 0.4% 活动感染),第一代移民中 患病率 最高,年龄、移民背景和性传播感染病史是关键决定因素;只有 9% 的活动性 HBV 病例知道自己的状况。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者解释说,荷兰的 HBV、HCV 和 HIV 血清流行率 仍然较低,但集中在意识有限的特定群体中,这凸显了持续基于人群的监测对于指导公共卫生政策的重要性。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现支持有针对性的预防、筛查和与护理挂钩的战略,以实现世卫组织 2030 年消除目标,强调需要对高危人群采取有针对性的干预措施。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 尽管样本量大和全国范围提高了可靠性,但由于横断面设计和无症状病例可能漏报,证据强度中等。

Weighted HBV seroprevalence remained stable across surveys (3%-5% past or present infection; < 0.4% active infection). HCV seroprevalence remained low (< 0.4%) and was highest among non-Western migrants. HIV prevalence was 0.1% and highest among non-Western migrants and men who have sex with men. papers.title: Differential Hepatitis B Surface Antigen Glycan Isomer Kinetics Between Tenofovir Alafenamide and Entecavir: Hepatocellular Carcinoma Risk Stratification in Hepatitis B e Antigen‐Positive Patients
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Nucleos(t)ide analog (NA) therapy suppresses hepatitis B virus (HBV) DNA, but residual hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) risk persists. O‐glycosylated hepatitis B surface antigen glycan isomer (HBsAgGi) uniquely reflects virion burden. We evaluated the impact of tenofovir alafenamide (TAF) versus entecavir (ETV) on 48‐week HBsAgGi kinetics and its utility in stratifying HCC risk in 90 NA‐naïve patients (ETV: 73; TAF: 17). A favourable response was defined as a reduction or maintenance of low HBsAgGi levels. TAF independently predicted a favourable response compared with ETV (penalised odds ratio 3.60, p = 0.030). A significant interaction occurred between HBeAg status and HBsAgGi response in relation to HCC development ( p = 0.038). In HBeAg‐positive patients, a poor response was associated with increased HCC risk (hazard ratio 7.34, 95% confidence interval [CI] 1.96–20.35, p = 0.001); however, the exact magnitude warrants cautious interpretation due to wide CIs. This association was absent in HBeAg‐negative cases. Adding HBsAgGi response to the aMAP score improved long‐term HCC prediction exclusively in the HBeAg‐positive cohort. As the assay targets genotype C‐specific O‐glycosylation, the findings cannot be generalised to genotypes A, B, or D. In conclusion, on‐treatment HBsAgGi response is a specific surrogate marker for stratifying residual HCC risk in HBeAg‐positive patients, and TAF is more effective than ETV in inducing these favourable kinetics.

papers.title: Factors Associated With Surface Antigen (HBsAg) Clearance in a Spanish Cohort of Chronic Hepatitis B Patients: Influence on the Long-Term Prognosis.
papers.abstract: The objective is to identify factors that contribute to hepatitis B surface antigen (HBsAg) clearance in patients with chronic hepatitis B (CHB) infection in an unselected, long-term follow-up hepatitis B open cohort in southern Spain. A prospective open cohort study of 453 patients with CHB infection was recruited in the Liver Unit of the Internal Department of two hospitals in Málaga (Spain) between 1991 and 2022 to assess the incidence of hepatitis B surface antigen (HBsAg) clearance during follow-up, identify factors related to it, and determine the influence that clearance had on the long-term prognosis. The duration of follow-up ranged from 0.5 to 36.08 years. A multivariate Cox regression analysis was conducted to identify factors associated with HBsAg clearance. The impact of clearance on long-term prognosis was evaluated using a combined prognostic end point: need for liver transplantation, liver complications, or liver-related mortality. The construction of time-to-event curves was achieved by employing the Kaplan-Meir method, with subsequent comparison of event occurrence between groups conducted via log-rank test. During the subsequent follow-up period, 96/453 patients (21.2%) lost surface antigen (1.96/100 patients per year). Multivariate Cox regression analysis identified as independent factors associated with HBsAg clearance: age at first assessment over 40 years: HR 2.21 (1.38-3.52); a baseline DNA HBV peak below 3.3log10 (< 2000 IU/mL): HR 3.44 (2.01-5.89); loss of hepatitis B e-antigen (HBeAg) during follow-up: HR 7.23 (3.87-13.50). The incidence of HBsAg clearance was 1.96 cases/100 patient-years. It was more frequent in patients older than 40 years, with baseline DNA-HBV below 3.3 log10 (< 2000 IU/mL), and in chronic HBeAg+ patients who lost HBeAg during follow-up. HBsAg clearance was associated with a better long-term hepatic prognosis.

papers.title_zh: 西班牙 队列研究 患者中与表面抗原 (HBsAg) 清除相关的因素:对长期预后的影响。
papers.source_body_en: The objective is to identify factors that contribute to hepatitis B surface antigen (HBsAg) clearance in patients with chronic hepatitis B (CHB) infection in an unselected, long-term follow-up hepatitis B open cohort in southern Spain. A prospective open cohort study of 453 patients with CHB infection was recruited in the Liver Unit of the Internal Department of two hospitals in Málaga (Spain) between 1991 and 2022 to assess the incidence of hepatitis B surface antigen (HBsAg) clearance during follow-up, identify factors related to it, and determine the influence that clearance had on the long-term prognosis. The duration of follow-up ranged from 0.5 to 36.08 years. A multivariate Cox regression analysis was conducted to identify factors associated with HBsAg clearance. The impact of clearance on long-term prognosis was evaluated using a combined prognostic end point: need for liver transplantation, liver complications, or liver-related mortality. The construction of time-to-event curves was achieved by employing the Kaplan-Meir method, with subsequent comparison of event occurrence between groups conducted via log-rank test. During the subsequent follow-up period, 96/453 patients (21.2%) lost surface antigen (1.96/100 patients per year). Multivariate Cox regression analysis identified as independent factors associated with HBsAg clearance: age at first assessment over 40 years: HR 2.21 (1.38-3.52); a baseline DNA HBV peak below 3.3log10 (< 2000 IU/mL): HR 3.44 (2.01-5.89); loss of hepatitis B e-antigen (HBeAg) during follow-up: HR 7.23 (3.87-13.50). The incidence of HBsAg clearance was 1.96 cases/100 patient-years. It was more frequent in patients older than 40 years, with baseline DNA-HBV below 3.3 log10 (< 2000 IU/mL), and in chronic HBeAg+ patients who lost HBeAg during follow-up. HBsAg clearance was associated with a better long-term hepatic prognosis.

papers.title: Absence of Detectable Anti‐ HDV Antibodies Among HBsAg ‐Positive Blood Donors, HIV ‐Infected Individuals and Patients With Chronic Hepatitis B in Sao Paulo, Brazil: Evaluation Using a Rapid Lateral Flow Assay
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Hepatitis Delta Virus (HDV) infection in HBV‐infected individuals is associated with severe clinical outcomes, and screening is recommended in HBsAg‐positive patients. We used a rapid lateral flow assay (LFA) to assess anti‐HDV antibodies in Brazil, where HDV is highly endemic in the North, while data from the Southeast, particularly São Paulo, remain limited. We conducted a retrospective cross‐sectional study to assess anti‐HDV antibodies among 46 HBsAg‐positive blood donors at Fundação Pró‐Sangue/Hemocentro de São Paulo, 381 patients with chronic hepatitis B from the Central Laboratory Division of HC‐FMUSP, and 189 individuals from the Hepatology Clinic of HC‐FMUSP (101 HIV‐infected and 88 chronically HBV‐infected). Anti‐HDV antibodies were detected using a validated LFA. Positive controls ( n = 24) included samples previously confirmed by ELISA and/or PCR, predominantly infected with HDV genotypes 3 and 8. Among 443,400 blood donations, 48 (0.01%) were positive for at least two HBV markers; of these, 46 were tested for HDV, and all were anti‐HDV negative. All 381 patients undergoing HBV viral load monitoring were anti‐HDV negative, as were all 189 patients receiving hepatology care, including those with HIV coinfection or advanced liver disease. The LFA correctly identified all control samples positive for both anti‐HDV antibodies and HDV RNA. The absence of detectable anti‐HDV among diverse at‐risk populations in São Paulo is consistent with the low endemicity of HDV infection in southeastern Brazil. These findings, together with the assay's high specificity in HDV RNA‐positive controls, support its potential utility as a screening tool for HDV infection in low‐prevalence settings.

source_records.abstract: Hepatitis Delta Virus (HDV) infection in HBV-infected individuals is associated with severe clinical outcomes, and screening is recommended in HBsAg-positive patients. analysis.summary_en: This study evaluated the prevalence of Hepatitis Delta Virus (HDV) infection in São Paulo, Brazil, using a rapid lateral flow assay (LFA) among HBsAg-positive blood donors, chronic hepatitis B patients, and HIV-infected individuals. The retrospective cross-sectional study included 46 blood donors, 381 chronic hepatitis B patients, and 189 hepatology clinic patients (101 HIV-infected and 88 HBV-infected). All tested samples were anti-HDV negative, consistent with low HDV endemicity in southeastern Brazil. The LFA showed high specificity in HDV RNA-positive controls, supporting its utility as a screening tool in low-prevalence settings. The findings provide valuable data for public health HDV surveillance strategies.

elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 我们进行了一项回顾性横断面研究,评估了圣保罗 Fundação Pro-Sangue/Hemocentro 的 46 名 HBsAg 阳性献血者、来自 HC-FMUSP 中心实验室部门的 381 名 慢性乙型肝炎 患者以及来自 HC-FMUSP 肝病诊所的 189 名患者(101 名 HIV 感染者和 88 名慢性病患者)的抗 HDV 抗体。乙肝病毒感染者)。
elements_zh.methods: 我们使用快速侧流分析 (LFA) 来评估巴西的抗丁型肝炎病毒抗体,丁型肝炎病毒在巴西北部高度流行,而东南部地区,特别是圣保罗的数据仍然有限。使用经过验证的 LFA 检测抗 HDV 抗体。阳性对照 (n = 24) 包括先前通过 ELISA 和/或 PCR 确认的样本,主要感染 HDV 基因型 3 和 8。
elements_zh.main_results: 在 443,400 份献血中,48 份(0.01%)至少两项 HBV 标志物呈阳性;其中 46 人接受了 HDV 检测,结果均为抗 HDV 阴性。所有 381 名接受 HBV 病毒载量监测的患者均为抗 HDV 阴性,所有 189 名接受肝病护理的患者(包括 HIV 合并感染或晚期肝病患者)均为阴性。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 圣保罗的不同高危人群中没有检测到抗丁型肝炎病毒,这与巴西东南部丁型肝炎病毒感染的低流行性是一致的。这些发现,加上该测定在 HDV RNA 阳性对照中的高特异性,支持其作为低 患病率 环境中 HDV 感染筛查工具的潜在用途。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 该研究提供了低流行地区丁型肝炎病毒 患病率 的宝贵数据,支持在此类环境中使用快速侧向层析检测进行丁型肝炎病毒筛查。这可以为 HDV 监测 的公共卫生策略和 HBV 感染人群的预防提供信息。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究是回顾性和横断面的,限制了因果推断。然而,大样本量和在对照中具有高特异性的经过验证的检测为研究结果提供了适度的可信度。

papers.title: The relationship between mutations in reverse transcriptase region of hepatitis B virus and progression of liver disease
papers.abstract: The specific objective of this study was to investigate mutations of Hepatitis B virus (HBV) reverse transcriptase (RT) region in Chinese HBV-infected patients at different stages and their association with the progression of liver disease. HBV RT regions in serum samples were amplified and sequenced from 384 patients with chronic HBV infection, including 100 asymptomatic carriers (ASC), 101 chronic hepatitis B, 96 liver cirrhosis, and 87 hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC). Further analysis of genotyping and AA substitution within RT was performed by the online HBV genotyping tool and MEGA7.0 software. A logistic regression model was used to explore the relationship between RT mutations and advanced liver disease (ALD). The mutation rate gradually increased from ASC to HCC (P for trend < 0.05). Logistic regression analysis showed that one RT site mutation, rtS106A/C, was significantly associated with the ALD. Multivariate regression analysis confirmed that two RT mutations, rtH55R/Q/K and rtS137T/Q/E, were independent risk factors for HBV-related HCC. The current study reveals that mutations within the RT region might be associated with the progression of HBV-related liver diseases and might serve as predictive biomarkers for patients with HBV infection at high risk of developing HCC.

analysis.research_question_and_background: Chronic hepatitis B virus (HBV) infection progresses to severe liver diseases such as hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC), yet the virological drivers of progression remain incompletely understood. The study aimed to determine whether mutations in the HBV reverse transcriptase (RT) region are associated with the progression of liver disease in Chinese patients.
analysis.study_design_and_population: This cross-sectional study sequenced HBV RT regions from serum samples of 384 Chinese patients with chronic HBV infection, stratified into four clinical groups: 100 asymptomatic carriers (ASC), 101 with chronic hepatitis B, 96 with liver cirrhosis, and 87 with HCC.
analysis.methods: HBV RT regions were amplified and sequenced, with genotyping and amino acid substitutions analyzed using an online HBV genotyping tool and MEGA7.0 software. Logistic regression models were applied to assess associations between RT mutations and advanced liver disease (ALD), including HCC.
analysis.main_results: The mutation rate in the RT region increased progressively from ASC to HCC (P for trend < 0.05). Logistic regression identified rtS106A/C as significantly associated with ALD, while multivariate analysis confirmed rtH55R/Q/K and rtS137T/Q/E as independent risk factors for HBV-related HCC.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpret these findings as evidence that specific RT mutations may serve as predictive biomarkers for disease progression in HBV-infected patients. The study highlights novel associations between rtH55R/Q/K and rtS137T/Q/E and HCC risk, suggesting potential utility in risk stratification.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: These results cautiously suggest that monitoring RT mutations, particularly rtH55R/Q/K and rtS137T/Q/E, could inform surveillance strategies and early intervention for patients at high risk of developing HCC. The findings may also guide future research into therapeutic targets within the RT region.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The cross-sectional design limits causal inference, and the study was conducted in a single region with a specific patient population, which may affect generalizability. The evidence strength is moderate due to potential unmeasured confounders and the absence of longitudinal follow-up.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigated whether mutations in the HBV reverse transcriptase (RT) region are linked to liver disease progression in 384 Chinese patients with chronic HBV infection. Logistic regression identified rtS106A/C as associated with advanced liver disease, while multivariate analysis confirmed rtH55R/Q/K and rtS137T/Q/E as independent risk factors for HBV-related HCC. The authors propose that these mutations could serve as predictive biomarkers for high-risk patients, potentially informing surveillance and early intervention strategies. However, the cross-sectional design and single-region sampling limit causal conclusions and generalizability, warranting cautious interpretation.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 慢性乙型肝炎 病毒 (HBV) 感染会进展为肝细胞癌 (HCC) 等严重肝脏疾病,但进展的病毒学驱动因素仍不完全清楚。该研究旨在确定 HBV 逆转录酶 (RT) 区域的 突变 是否与中国患者的肝病进展相关。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 这项横断面研究对 384 名中国慢性 HBV 感染患者的血清样本中的 HBV RT 区域进行了测序,分为四个临床组:100 名无症状携带者 (ASC)、101 名 慢性乙型肝炎、96 名肝硬化患者和 87 名 HCC 患者。
elements_zh.methods: 使用在线 HBV 基因分型工具和 MEGA7.0 软件对 HBV RT 区域进行扩增和测序,并进行基因分型和氨基酸取代分析。应用逻辑回归模型评估 RT 突变 与晚期肝病 (ALD)(包括 HCC)之间的关联。
elements_zh.main_results: RT 区域的 突变 率从 ASC 到 HCC 逐渐增加(趋势 P < 0.05)。Logistic 回归确定 rtS106A/C 与 ALD 显着相关,而多变量分析证实 rtH55R/Q/K 和 rtS137T/Q/E 是 HBV 相关 HCC 的独立危险因素。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者将这些发现解释为特定 RT 突变 可以作为 HBV 感染患者疾病进展的预测生物标志物的证据。该研究强调了 rtH55R/Q/K 和 rtS137T/Q/E 与 HCC 风险之间的新关联,表明风险分层的潜在实用性。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些结果谨慎地表明,监测 RT 突变,特别是 rtH55R/Q/K 和 rtS137T/Q/E,可以为 监测 策略和对发生 HCC 高风险患者的早期干预提供信息。这些发现还可能指导未来对 RT 区域内治疗靶点的研究。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 横断面设计限制了因果推断,并且该研究是在具有特定患者群体的单一地区进行的,这可能会影响普遍性。由于潜在的未测量的混杂因素和缺乏纵向随访,证据强度中等。

analysis_zh.research_question_and_background: 慢性乙型肝炎 病毒 (HBV) 感染会进展为肝细胞癌 (HCC) 等严重肝脏疾病,但进展的病毒学驱动因素仍不完全清楚。该研究旨在确定 HBV 逆转录酶 (RT) 区域的 突变 是否与中国患者的肝病进展相关。
analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 这项横断面研究对 384 名中国慢性 HBV 感染患者的血清样本中的 HBV RT 区域进行了测序,分为四个临床组:100 名无症状携带者 (ASC)、101 名 慢性乙型肝炎、96 名肝硬化患者和 87 名 HCC 患者。
analysis_zh.methods: 使用在线 HBV 基因分型工具和 MEGA7.0 软件对 HBV RT 区域进行扩增和测序,并进行基因分型和氨基酸取代分析。应用逻辑回归模型评估 RT 突变 与晚期肝病 (ALD)(包括 HCC)之间的关联。
analysis_zh.main_results: RT 区域的 突变 率从 ASC 到 HCC 逐渐增加(趋势 P < 0.05)。Logistic 回归确定 rtS106A/C 与 ALD 显着相关,而多变量分析证实 rtH55R/Q/K 和 rtS137T/Q/E 是 HBV 相关 HCC 的独立危险因素。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者将这些发现解释为特定 RT 突变 可以作为 HBV 感染患者疾病进展的预测生物标志物的证据。该研究强调了 rtH55R/Q/K 和 rtS137T/Q/E 与 HCC 风险之间的新关联,表明风险分层的潜在实用性。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些结果谨慎地表明,监测 RT 突变,特别是 rtH55R/Q/K 和 rtS137T/Q/E,可以为 监测 策略和对发生 HCC 高风险患者的早期干预提供信息。这些发现还可能指导未来对 RT 区域内治疗靶点的研究。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 横断面设计限制了因果推断,并且该研究是在具有特定患者群体的单一地区进行的,这可能会影响普遍性。由于潜在的未测量的混杂因素和缺乏纵向随访,证据强度中等。

papers.title: HBV PreS/S gene mutations in patients with chronic hepatitis B
papers.abstract: Variants in the hepatitis B virus (HBV) PreS/S gene have been suggested to contribute to the development of progressive liver disease. This study aimed to evaluate the association between HBV PreS/S variations and liver histopathology in patients with chronic hepatitis B. A total of 109 patients under clinical follow-up for chronic hepatitis B were included. The HBV PreS/S gene was amplified by PCR and sequenced using the Sanger method. Amino acid substitutions, nonsense mutations, and deletions were analyzed in relation to liver fibrosis stage. Overall, 58 of 389 amino acid sites (14.9%) in the HBV PreS/S gene showed substitutions, with the highest mutation rate observed in the PreS2 region (27.27%). Mutations L54P (PreS1), F130L/S (PreS2), and S207R/N/I/T and I208T (S gene) were significantly more frequent in patients with advanced fibrosis (F ≥ 3) (p < 0.05). Multivariable analysis identified S207R/N/I/T as an independent risk factor for liver fibrosis. Patients with PreS2 mutations had higher fibrosis scores (p < 0.05). The S207R/N/I/T mutation in the C-terminal region of the HBV S protein is independently associated with liver fibrosis, while PreS2 mutations may contribute to fibrosis progression in chronic hepatitis B.

papers.title: METTL14 Downregulation Accelerates HBV‐Related Cirrhosis and Hepatocellular Carcinoma by Promoting Type I Interferon Release via the cGAS–STING Pathway Through m 6 A Modification
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT The pathogenesis of Hepatitis B virus (HBV)‐related cirrhosis and hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) has not been fully elucidated at present. While METTL14 is crucial in innate immunity, its specific role in HBV‐related liver disease progression is unclear. We analyzed METTL14 expression in patient tissues and bioinformatics datasets. Mouse models of HBV‐related cirrhosis and HCC were established to evaluate liver injury, fibrosis, and tumorigenesis. Mechanistic studies utilized MeRIPqPCR, RIP, and Actinomycin D assays, and hepatocyte‐stellate cell co‐cultures to investigate METTL14's impact on cGAS mRNA stability, the cGAS‐STING pathway, and IFNB1 secretion. METTL14 was downregulated in HBV infection, cirrhosis, and HCC. METTL14 knockdown aggravated liver injury, fibrosis, and tumor formation in mice. Mechanistic studies revealed that METTL14 overexpression in HBV‐infected hepatocytes promoted the degradation of cGAS mRNA by increasing its m6A modification, thereby suppressing the cGAS–STING pathway activation and IFNB1 release. Consequently, METTL14 overexpression inhibited stellate cell activation, which was reversed by cGAS‐STING agonists. Downregulation of METTL14 reduces the degradation of cGAS mRNA through m 6 A modification, facilitates the cGAS–STING pathway activation and IFNB1 release, thereby accelerating HBV‐related cirrhosis and HCC progressions.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 乙型肝炎病毒(HBV)相关肝硬化和肝细胞癌(HCC)的发病机制目前尚未完全阐明。虽然 METTL14 在先天免疫中至关重要,但其在 HBV 相关肝病进展中的具体作用尚不清楚。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 建立了 HBV 相关肝硬化和 HCC 小鼠模型,以评估肝损伤、纤维化和肿瘤发生。我们分析了患者组织和生物信息学数据集中的 METTL14 表达。

elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: METTL14的下调通过m6A修饰减少cGAS mRNA的降解,促进cGAS-STING通路激活和IFNB1释放,从而加速HBV​​相关的肝硬化和HCC进展。因此,METTL14 过表达抑制星状细胞激活,cGAS-STING 激动剂可逆转这种激活。

elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究主要使用小鼠模型和体外测定,这可能无法完全概括人类疾病的复杂性。由于机械见解,证据强度中等,但由于缺乏人类干预数据而受到限制。

papers.title: Chronic hepatitis B in a large private hospital network in Türkiye: Clinical characteristics and electronic health record-data gaps
papers.abstract: BACKGROUND: Türkiye has intermediate hepatitis B virus (HBV) infection prevalence and an additional burden of hepatitis D virus (HDV). Large-scale real-world data describing adults with chronic HBV-infection and the completeness of routinely collected electronic health record (EHR) data for HBV monitoring and surveillance is not well characterized. METHODS: A retrospective, cross-sectional study using EHR data from a multicenter private hospital network, including 18,284 adult patients with chronic HBV infection between 2017 and 2025 was conducted. The primary analysis included 17,927 adults with HBV monoinfection, defined as patients without a recorded ICD-10 B18.0 diagnosis code for chronic HBV with delta agent. We described demographic and clinical characteristics, liver disease outcomes, and the availability and consistency of key EHR variables relevant to HBV care, including ALT, HBV DNA, HBeAg, anti-HDV testing, B18.0 diagnosis coding, and structured treatment documentation. RESULTS: Among adult patients with HBV monoinfection, 60.6% were male and the mean age was 53.5 years (SD 14.5). Cirrhosis and hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) were recorded in 11.1% and 3.4% of patients, respectively, and were more common among men and older adults. Baseline ALT values were available for 45.5% of HBV monoinfected patients. Among patients without cirrhosis, HCC, or liver failure, both HBV DNA and HBeAg status were available for 1274 of 15,243 patients. Documented anti-HDV testing was available for 2213 of 18,284 patients (12.1%), while 357 patients (2.0%) had recorded B18.0 diagnosis code; only 76 of these 357 patients also had documented anti-HDV testing in available EHR field. CONCLUSIONS: In this large private-sector EHR cohort of adults with recorded chronic HBV infection, cirrhosis and HCC were common, particularly among older adults and men. The findings should not be interpreted as national HBV prevalence estimates, but they demonstrate the value of private-sector EHR data for characterizing diagnosed HBV care while highlighting gaps in laboratory monitoring, HDV documentation, and treatment data needed to support HBV surveillance and elimination efforts.

analysis.summary_en: This study analyzed the clinical characteristics and electronic health record (EHR) data gaps of chronic hepatitis B virus (HBV) infection in a large private hospital network in Türkiye. It found that cirrhosis and hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) were common, particularly among older adults and men. Baseline ALT values were available for only 45.5% of patients, and HBV DNA and HBeAg status were documented in 8.3% of those without cirrhosis, HCC, or liver failure. The study highlights the importance of private-sector EHR data for HBV care but also identifies significant gaps in laboratory monitoring, HDV documentation, and treatment data. These findings suggest the need for improved data collection and integration to support HBV surveillance and elimination efforts.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 土耳其有中度 乙型肝炎病毒 (HBV) 感染和丁型肝炎病毒 (HDV) 的额外负担。该研究旨在描述慢性 HBV 感染的临床特征,并评估用于 HBV 监测和 监测 的电子健康记录 (EHR) 数据的完整性。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 使用来自多中心私立医院网络的电子健康记录 (EHR) 数据进行了一项回顾性横断面研究,包括 2017 年至 2025 年间 18,284 名慢性 HBV 感染的成年患者。主要分析包括 17,927 名 HBV 单一感染的成人,定义为没有记录的使用 delta 剂慢性 HBV 的 ICD-10 B18.0 诊断 代码的患者。
elements_zh.methods: 该研究使用来自多中心私立医院网络的 EHR 数据来分析人口和临床特征、肝病结果以及与 HBV 护理相关的关键 EHR 变量的可用性和一致性,包括 ALT、HBV DNA、HBeAg、抗 HDV 检测、B18.0 诊断 编码和结构化 治疗 文档。
elements_zh.main_results: 在成人乙型肝炎单一感染患者中,60.6%为男性,平均年龄为53.5岁(标准差14.5)。肝硬化和肝细胞癌 (HCC) 分别占 11.1% 和 3.4% 的患者,且在男性和老年人中更为常见。45.5% 的 HBV 单一感染患者可获得基线 ALT 值。在没有肝硬化、HCC 或肝功能衰竭的患者中,15,243 名患者中有 1274 名患者的 HBV DNA 和 HBeAg 状态均可用。18,284 名患者中的 2213 名 (12.1%) 可以进行有记录的抗 HDV 检测,而 357 名患者 (2.0%) 记录了 B18.0 诊断 代码;这 357 名患者中只有 76 名在可用的 EHR 领域也有抗 HDV 检测记录。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者解释说,在这个大型私营 EHR 队列研究 记录有慢性 HBV 感染的成年人中,肝硬化和 HCC 很常见,尤其是老年人和男性。该研究强调了支持 HBV 监测 和消除工作所需的实验室监测、丁型肝炎文件和 治疗 数据方面的差距。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果证明了私营部门 EHR 数据对于描述诊断出的 HBV 护理特征的价值,并强调需要改进实验室监测、HDV 记录和 治疗 数据以支持 HBV 监测 和消除工作。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究仅限于私营部门 EHR 队列研究,并不代表国家 HBV 患病率 估计值。证据强度中等,因为研究结果基于回顾性数据并强调数据完整性方面的差距,而不是提供明确的结论。

analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果证明了私营部门 EHR 数据对于描述诊断出的 HBV 护理特征的价值,并强调需要改进实验室监测、HDV 记录和 治疗 数据以支持 HBV 监测 和消除工作。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究仅限于私营部门 EHR 队列研究,并不代表国家 HBV 患病率 估计值。证据强度中等,因为研究结果基于回顾性数据并强调数据完整性方面的差距,而不是提供明确的结论。

papers.title: The Silent Burden of Hepatitis B-Related Stigma.
papers.abstract: Individuals experiencing stigma related to chronic hepatitis B virus (HBV) infection often experience negative self-beliefs, isolation, discrimination, and reduced willingness to engage with healthcare professionals. We aimed to understand the patient perspective of HBV-related stigma and to summarize the patient experience of stigma in a patient-centric conceptual model. Eligible adult participants with a confirmed diagnosis of chronic HBV infection were recruited from the US, China, and Poland. Qualitative, semi-structured, concept elicitation interviews of approximately 60 min were conducted to explore participants' experiences of stigma. Qualitative analysis of interview data was conducted using Thematic Analysis methods with concepts categorized into domains and pre-determined stigma types. A total of 28 participants were recruited from the US (n = 11), China (n = 11), and Poland (n = 6). Internalized stigma was reported by all participants (n = 28; 100%), social stigma was reported by 79% (n = 22) of participants, and institutional stigma was reported by 57% (n = 16) of participants. Seven domains across condition-specific and health-related quality of life (HRQoL) concepts were identified to create a patient-centric conceptual model of the experience of stigma associated with HBV infection. Each domain was reported by at least half of the participants, with social functioning (n = 28; 100%), emotional wellbeing (n = 27; 96%), and HBV transmission (n = 27; 96%) most frequently reported. Experiences of stigma were highly inter-related. Experiences of HBV-related stigma were highly pervasive, with widespread impact on HRQoL. To address the burden of stigma, reducing internalized stigma would be most impactful as this was the most common and bothersome.

analysis.research_question_and_background: Chronic hepatitis B virus (HBV) infection is associated with stigma that can lead to negative self-perceptions, social isolation, discrimination, and reduced healthcare engagement. The study sought to elucidate the patient perspective of HBV-related stigma and to construct a patient-centric conceptual model of this experience.
analysis.study_design_and_population: This qualitative study recruited 28 adults with confirmed chronic HBV infection from the US (n=11), China (n=11), and Poland (n=6) through purposive sampling. Semi-structured interviews of approximately 60 minutes were conducted to explore stigma experiences.
analysis.methods: Qualitative interviews were analyzed using Thematic Analysis to categorize stigma concepts into domains and pre-determined stigma types. A patient-centric conceptual model was developed to organize the identified stigma domains.
analysis.main_results: Internalized stigma was reported by all 28 participants (100%), social stigma by 22 participants (79%), and institutional stigma by 16 participants (57%). analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpret that HBV-related stigma is highly pervasive and inter-related, with internalized stigma being the most common and bothersome, suggesting targeted interventions should prioritize reducing internalized stigma to improve health-related quality of life.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings highlight the need for stigma-reduction strategies in HBV care, particularly addressing internalized stigma, to improve patient engagement with healthcare and overall quality of life across diverse global settings.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The small sample size (n=28) and qualitative design limit generalizability, and the study did not include participants from regions beyond the US, China, and Poland, which may restrict the conceptual model's applicability to other populations. analysis.summary_en: This qualitative study explored the patient experience of stigma associated with chronic hepatitis B virus (HBV) infection through semi-structured interviews with 28 adults from the US, China, and Poland. All participants reported internalized stigma, 79% reported social stigma, and 57% reported institutional stigma. Seven stigma-related domains were identified, with social functioning, emotional wellbeing, and HBV transmission most frequently reported. The authors conclude that HBV-related stigma is pervasive and inter-related, with internalized stigma being the most common and bothersome, and recommend prioritizing interventions to reduce internalized stigma to improve health-related quality of life and healthcare engagement.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 慢性乙型肝炎 病毒 (HBV) 感染与耻辱相关,可能导致消极的自我认知、社会孤立、歧视和医疗保健参与度降低。该研究试图阐明患者对乙型肝炎相关耻辱的看法,并构建以患者为中心的这种经历的概念模型。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 这项定性研究通过有目的的抽样,招募了来自美国 (n=11)、中国 (n=11) 和波兰 (n=6) 的 28 名确诊为慢性 HBV 感染的成年人。进行了大约 60 分钟的半结构化访谈来探讨耻辱经历。
elements_zh.methods: 使用主题分析对定性访谈进行分析,将污名概念分类为领域和预先确定的污名类型。开发了以患者为中心的概念模型来组织已识别的耻辱域。
elements_zh.main_results: 所有 28 名参与者(100%)报告了内在的耻辱,22 名参与者(79%)报告了社会耻辱,16 名参与者(57%)报告了机构耻辱。确定了七个领域,其中最常报告的是社会功能 (100%)、情绪健康 (96%) 和 HBV 传播 (96%)。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者解释说,与乙型肝炎相关的耻辱非常普遍且相互关联,其中内在耻辱是最常见和令人烦恼的,这表明有针对性的干预措施应优先考虑减少内在耻辱,以改善与健康相关的生活质量。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果强调,在乙型肝炎护理中需要采取减少耻辱感的策略,特别是解决内在的耻辱感,以​​提高患者在全球不同环境中的医疗保健参与度和整体生活质量。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 小样本量(n = 28)和定性设计限制了普遍性,并且该研究不包括来自美国、中国和波兰以外地区的参与者,这可能会限制概念模型对其他人群的适用性。由于这些限制,证据强度被评估为中等。

analysis_zh.main_results: 所有 28 名参与者(100%)报告了内在的耻辱,22 名参与者(79%)报告了社会耻辱,16 名参与者(57%)报告了机构耻辱。确定了七个领域,其中最常报告的是社会功能 (100%)、情绪健康 (96%) 和 HBV 传播 (96%)。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者解释说,与乙型肝炎相关的耻辱非常普遍且相互关联,其中内在耻辱是最常见和令人烦恼的,这表明有针对性的干预措施应优先考虑减少内在耻辱,以改善与健康相关的生活质量。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果强调,在乙型肝炎护理中需要采取减少耻辱感的策略,特别是解决内在的耻辱感,以​​提高患者在全球不同环境中的医疗保健参与度和整体生活质量。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 小样本量(n = 28)和定性设计限制了普遍性,并且该研究不包括来自美国、中国和波兰以外地区的参与者,这可能会限制概念模型对其他人群的适用性。由于这些限制,证据强度被评估为中等。

papers.title: Knowledge, Attitudes and Practices Toward Hepatitis B Virus Among Transfusion‐Dependent Thalassemia Patients in Jordan
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Background Knowledge, attitudes, and practices (KAP) studies provide essential insight into public awareness, perceptions, and behaviors toward health issues. Hepatitis B virus (HBV) remains a major public health problem in Jordan. Transfusion‐dependent patients are at higher risk of infection due to frequent exposure to blood products. This study aimed to assess KAP toward HBV among transfusion‐dependent patients in Jordan. Methods A cross‐sectional study was conducted among 407 transfusion‐dependent patients attending hematology clinics in governmental hospitals in Jordan. A validated questionnaire assessed socio‐demographic data and KAP regarding HBV. Knowledge, attitude, and practice were each scored out of their respective items; participants scoring ≥ 75% correct were classified as having good knowledge, positive attitude, or safe practices, respectively. Statistical analyses included descriptive statistics, chi‐square tests, and logistic regression to determine associations, with p ‐values < 0.05 considered significant. Results Of the 407 participants, 114 (28%) had good knowledge, 170 (41.8%) had positive attitudes, and 156 (38.3%) demonstrated safe practices toward HBV. Key predictors of good knowledge included older age (AOR 3.81, 95% CI 2.09–6.94) and higher education (AOR 3.05, 95% CI 1.80–5.16). Safe practice was significantly associated with family history of HBV infection. Significant associations were found between knowledge scores and educational level, employment status, and history of HBV vaccination ( p < 0.05). Conclusion HBV knowledge, attitudes, and practices among transfusion‐dependent patients in Jordan were suboptimal. These findings highlight the need for targeted health education programs and HBV vaccination campaigns for this high‐risk group.

papers.title: Advances in Viral Markers for Predicting Functional Cure of Chronic Hepatitis B
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT First‐line antiviral therapies for chronic hepatitis B include nucleos(t)ide analogues and pegylated interferon‐α. However, neither therapy can completely eliminate hepatocellular covalently closed circular DNA, making complete cure currently unattainable. Functional cure, primarily defined as sustained hepatitis B surface antigen loss, is the optimal therapeuticgoal for chronic hepatitis B. Although combined or sequential nucleos(t)ide analogues/pegylated interferon‐α regimens improve hepatitis B surface antigen seroclearance rates, only a minority of patients achieve this outcome. Therefore, quantification of hepatitis B virus viral markers using standard clinical assays is essential for predicting functional cure before treatment and during therapeutic monitoring. Early identification of patients likely to achieve hepatitis B surface antigen may help loss improve cure rates and potentially reduce medical costs. This review summarizes recent advances in viral markers for predicting functional cure in chronic hepatitis B, evaluates the predictive performance of individual markers, and provides evidence to optimize clinical treatment strategies.

analysis.scope_and_question: The review focuses on hepatitis B virus (HBV) infection, specifically chronic hepatitis B, and the use of viral markers to predict a functional cure. The central question is how to optimize clinical treatment strategies for chronic hepatitis B by evaluating the predictive performance of individual viral markers. The review does not report on databases, study counts, pooled estimates, or recommendations.
analysis.evidence_base_and_review_method: The review is a narrative synthesis of recent advances in viral markers for predicting functional cure in chronic hepatitis B. It evaluates the predictive performance of individual markers and provides evidence to optimize clinical treatment strategies. The review does not report on the type of review, databases, search dates, eligibility criteria, selection method, included-study count, meta-analysis, or consensus process.
analysis.consensus_and_key_conclusions: The review concludes that functional cure, defined as sustained hepatitis B surface antigen loss, is the optimal therapeutic goal for chronic hepatitis B. It also notes that combined or sequential nucleos(t)ide analogues/pegylated interferon-α regimens improve hepatitis B surface antigen seroclearance rates, but only a minority of patients achieve this outcome. The review does not report on pooled estimates or stable conclusions.
analysis.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: The review highlights that neither first-line antiviral therapies nor combined regimens can completely eliminate hepatocellular covalently closed circular DNA, making a complete cure currently unattainable. It also notes that only a minority of patients achieve hepatitis B surface antigen seroclearance. The review does not report on heterogeneity, conflicting findings, weak methods, missing populations or regions, or unresolved mechanisms.
analysis.research_and_practice_implications: The review suggests that quantification of hepatitis B virus viral markers using standard clinical assays is essential for predicting functional cure before treatment and during therapeutic monitoring. It also notes that early identification of patients likely to achieve hepatitis B surface antigen loss may help improve cure rates and potentially reduce medical costs. The review does not report on future priorities for research, surveillance, diagnosis, treatment, vaccination, ecology, risk assessment, or policy.

The review provides evidence to optimize clinical treatment strategies for chronic hepatitis B.

elements_zh.scope_and_question: 该综述重点关注 乙型肝炎病毒 (HBV) 感染,特别是 慢性乙型肝炎,以及使用病毒标记来预测 功能性治愈。核心问题是如何通过评估单个病毒标志物的预测性能来优化 慢性乙型肝炎 的临床 治疗 策略。该综述不报告数据库、研究计数、汇总估计或建议。
elements_zh.evidence_base_and_review_method: 该综述是对用于预测 慢性乙型肝炎 中的 功能性治愈 的病毒标记的最新进展的叙述性综合。它评估单个标志物的预测性能,并为优化临床 治疗 策略提供证据。该综述不报告综述类型、数据库、检索日期、资格标准、选择方法、纳入研究计数、荟萃分析或共识过程。
elements_zh.consensus_and_key_conclusions: 综述得出的结论是,功能性治愈(定义为乙型肝炎表面抗原持续丧失)是 慢性乙型肝炎 的最佳治疗目标。它还指出,联合或序贯核苷类似物/聚乙二醇化干扰素-α 方案可提高乙型肝炎表面抗原血清清除率,但只有少数患者达到这一结果。该审查不报告汇总估计或稳定结论。
elements_zh.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: 该综述强调,一线 抗病毒药物 疗法和联合疗法都无法完全消除肝细胞共价闭合环状 DNA,目前无法实现彻底治愈。它还指出,只有少数患者达到乙型肝炎表面抗原血清清除。该综述不报告异质性、相互矛盾的发现、薄弱的方法、缺失的人群或区域或未解决的机制。
elements_zh.research_and_practice_implications: 该综述表明,使用标准临床测定对 乙型肝炎病毒 病毒标记物进行量化对于在 治疗 之前和治疗监测期间预测 功能性治愈 至关重要。它还指出,早期识别可能实现乙型肝炎表面抗原丧失的患者可能有助于提高治愈率并可能降低医疗费用。该审查不报告未来研究、监测、诊断、治疗、疫苗接种、生态、风险评估或政策的优先事项。

analysis_zh.consensus_and_key_conclusions: 综述得出的结论是,功能性治愈(定义为乙型肝炎表面抗原持续丧失)是 慢性乙型肝炎 的最佳治疗目标。它还指出,联合或序贯核苷类似物/聚乙二醇化干扰素-α 方案可提高乙型肝炎表面抗原血清清除率,但只有少数患者达到这一结果。该审查不报告汇总估计或稳定结论。
analysis_zh.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: 该综述强调,一线 抗病毒药物 疗法和联合疗法都无法完全消除肝细胞共价闭合环状 DNA,目前无法实现彻底治愈。它还指出,只有少数患者达到乙型肝炎表面抗原血清清除。该综述不报告异质性、相互矛盾的发现、薄弱的方法、缺失的人群或区域或未解决的机制。
analysis_zh.research_and_practice_implications: 该综述表明,使用标准临床测定对 乙型肝炎病毒 病毒标记物进行量化对于在 治疗 之前和治疗监测期间预测 功能性治愈 至关重要。它还指出,早期识别可能实现乙型肝炎表面抗原丧失的患者可能有助于提高治愈率并可能降低医疗费用。该审查不报告未来研究、监测、诊断、治疗、疫苗接种、生态、风险评估或政策的优先事项。

papers.title: Therapeutic Potential of the Novel Monoclonal Antibody 7-4G against HBsAg in a Mouse Model of Chronic Hepatitis B Virus Infection
papers.abstract: Abstract Chronic hepatitis B virus (HBV) infection remains a major global health challenge because current antiviral therapies rarely achieve complete viral clearance. We evaluated the antiviral activity of a newly developed monoclonal antibody, 7-4G mAb, directed against the hepatitis B surface antigen (HBsAg). The antibody showed specific binding to the p27 component of HBsAg and efficiently removed HBV-related particles from patient serum in vitro. Significant HBV neutralizing activity of 7-4G mAb was observed in primary human hepatocytes and in humanized mouse models. In persistently HBV-infected PXB mice, a single administration of 7-4G mAb, either alone or in combination with another monoclonal antibody, reduced serum HBsAg levels and HBV DNA levels by two orders magnitude for two weeks after the treatment. In half of the treated mice, suppression of both viral markers was maintained through the study period, whereas rebound occurred within three to four weeks in the remaining animals. In addition, 7-4G mAb enhanced the HBV DNA-lowering effect of entecavir, a known anti-HBV drug. These findings support the further development of 7-4G mAb as part of an innovative HBV treatment strategy, addressing limitations of existing therapies and advancing toward a more effective HBV management solution.

analysis.research_question_and_background: Chronic hepatitis B virus (HBV) infection remains a major global health challenge because current antiviral therapies rarely achieve complete viral clearance.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study evaluated the antiviral activity of a newly developed monoclonal antibody, 7-4G mAb, directed against the hepatitis B surface antigen (HBsAg) in primary human hepatocytes and humanized mouse models.
analysis.methods: The antibody was tested for specific binding to the p27 component of HBsAg and its ability to remove HBV-related particles from patient serum in vitro, with further assessment in persistently HBV-infected PXB mice.
analysis.main_results: Significant HBV neutralizing activity of 7-4G mAb was observed in primary human hepatocytes and humanized mouse models; a single administration reduced serum HBsAg and HBV DNA levels by two orders of magnitude for two weeks, with suppression maintained in half of the treated mice through the study period.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The findings support the further development of 7-4G mAb as part of an innovative HBV treatment strategy, addressing limitations of existing therapies and advancing toward a more effective HBV management solution.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The study demonstrates that 7-4G mAb can significantly reduce viral markers in a mouse model and enhance the HBV DNA-lowering effect of entecavir, offering potential for improved HBV treatment strategies.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The evidence is based on in vitro and animal model studies, with rebound occurring in some animals within three to four weeks, indicating a need for further research to assess long-term efficacy and human applicability.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigated the therapeutic potential of a novel monoclonal antibody, 7-4G mAb, against HBsAg in chronic hepatitis B virus infection. The antibody showed specific binding to HBsAg and efficiently removed HBV particles from patient serum in vitro. In humanized mouse models, a single administration of 7-4G mAb significantly reduced serum HBsAg and HBV DNA levels by two orders of magnitude for two weeks, with suppression maintained in half of the treated mice. The antibody also enhanced the HBV DNA-lowering effect of entecavir. These findings suggest that 7-4G mAb could be part of an innovative HBV treatment strategy, though rebound occurred in some animals, indicating the need for further research on long-term efficacy.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 慢性乙型肝炎 病毒 (HBV) 感染仍然是全球主要的健康挑战,因为目前的 慢性乙型肝炎 疗法很少能实现完全病毒清除。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究评估了新开发的单克隆抗体 7-4G mAb 在原代人肝细胞和人源化小鼠模型中针对乙型肝炎表面抗原 (HBsAg) 的 抗病毒药物 活性。
elements_zh.methods: 该抗体在体外测试了与 HBsAg 的 p27 成分的特异性结合及其从患者血清中去除 HBV 相关颗粒的能力,并在持续感染 HBV 的 PXB 小鼠中进行了进一步评估。
elements_zh.main_results: 在原代人肝细胞和人源化小鼠模型中观察到 7-4G mAb 具有显着的 HBV 中和活性;单次给药可将血清 HBsAg 和 HBV DNA 水平降低两个数量级,持续两周,并且在整个研究期间,一半的治疗小鼠保持抑制状态。

papers.title_zh: 新型单克隆抗体 7-4G 对 慢性乙型肝炎 病毒感染小鼠模型中 HBsAg 的治疗潜力
papers.source_body_en: Abstract Chronic hepatitis B virus (HBV) infection remains a major global health challenge because current antiviral therapies rarely achieve complete viral clearance. We evaluated the antiviral activity of a newly developed monoclonal antibody, 7-4G mAb, directed against the hepatitis B surface antigen (HBsAg). The antibody showed specific binding to the p27 component of HBsAg and efficiently removed HBV-related particles from patient serum in vitro. Significant HBV neutralizing activity of 7-4G mAb was observed in primary human hepatocytes and in humanized mouse models. In persistently HBV-infected PXB mice, a single administration of 7-4G mAb, either alone or in combination with another monoclonal antibody, reduced serum HBsAg levels and HBV DNA levels by two orders magnitude for two weeks after the treatment. In half of the treated mice, suppression of both viral markers was maintained through the study period, whereas rebound occurred within three to four weeks in the remaining animals. In addition, 7-4G mAb enhanced the HBV DNA-lowering effect of entecavir, a known anti-HBV drug. These findings support the further development of 7-4G mAb as part of an innovative HBV treatment strategy, addressing limitations of existing therapies and advancing toward a more effective HBV management solution.

papers.title: Longitudinal Patterns of Chronic Hepatitis B Care and Treatment Adherence in Australia: A National Linked Data Cohort Study.
papers.abstract: Current uptake of chronic hepatitis B (CHB) treatment and care in Australia is well below target levels, leading to an ongoing burden of preventable liver disease and cancer. Understanding individual-level trajectories of care engagement and variation by sociodemographic factors is essential to guide efforts to improve access to and retention in care. This study analysed records of hepatitis B viral load (VL) testing and antiviral treatment provided through Australia's national health insurance system, which were linked to migration, death, and sociodemographic data from various government datasets. Treatment and VL testing by population group were assessed, and uptake was calculated using modelled estimates of the number living with CHB. VL testing frequency and treatment adherence based on scripts dispensed were also assessed. Of the estimated 219,800 people living with CHB in Australia in 2023, 118,334 (53.8%) received either VL testing or treatment during 2014-2023. Estimated uptake of VL testing and treatment uptake were lower among Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander people and also varied by region of birth. Of the 81,360 who received any VL testing, only 17,352 (21.3%) received it regularly, while 31,715 (39.0%) had evidence of prior monitoring but no VL testing since 2019. The majority of those who initiated treatment continued therapy and received supply sufficient for adherence. This study shows that substantial gaps exist in CHB care in Australia, particularly in continued monitoring among those not on treatment. Disparities in uptake are evident by priority population. Re-engaging those lost to follow-up should be prioritised.

analysis.research_question_and_background: Chronic hepatitis B (CHB) treatment and care uptake in Australia remains below targets, contributing to preventable liver disease and cancer, highlighting a need to understand individual-level care trajectories and sociodemographic disparities.
analysis.study_design_and_population: This national linked data cohort study analysed records of hepatitis B viral load testing and antiviral treatment from Australia's national health insurance system, linked to migration, death, and sociodemographic datasets.
analysis.methods: Treatment and viral load testing uptake were assessed using modelled estimates of the number of people living with CHB, with frequency of testing and treatment adherence evaluated based on scripts dispensed.
analysis.main_results: Of the estimated 219,800 people living with CHB in Australia in 2023, 118,334 (53.8%) received either viral load testing or treatment during 2014–2023, with only 21.3% of those tested receiving regular monitoring.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The study identifies substantial gaps in CHB care, particularly in continued monitoring among those not on treatment, and highlights disparities by priority populations such as Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander people and region of birth.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings underscore the need to re-engage individuals lost to follow-up and prioritise equitable access to viral load monitoring and treatment to reduce preventable liver disease and cancer burden.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study relies on administrative data, which may underestimate true care engagement and lacks detailed clinical or virological outcomes, limiting causal inference and generalisability to broader populations.

analysis.summary_en: This national linked data cohort study evaluated chronic hepatitis B (CHB) care and treatment adherence in Australia using records from the national health insurance system linked to migration, death, and sociodemographic datasets. Among an estimated 219,800 people living with CHB in 2023, only 53.8% received viral load testing or treatment during 2014–2023, with just 21.3% of those tested receiving regular monitoring. Disparities were evident among Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander people and by region of birth. While most who initiated treatment continued therapy, substantial gaps persisted in monitoring among untreated individuals. The study highlights the urgent need to re-engage those lost to follow-up and address inequities to reduce preventable liver disease and cancer burden.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 慢性乙型肝炎 (CHB) 治疗 和澳大利亚的护理利用率仍低于目标,导致可预防的肝病和癌症,凸显了了解个人护理轨迹和社会人口差异的必要性。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 这项国家关联数据 队列研究 研究分析了澳大利亚国家健康保险系统中的乙型肝炎病毒载量检测记录和 抗病毒药物 治疗 记录,与移民、死亡和社会人口统计数据集相关联。
elements_zh.methods: 使用慢性乙型肝炎患者人数的模型估计来评估 治疗 和病毒载量测试的采用情况,并根据分发的脚本评估测试频率和 治疗 依从性。
elements_zh.main_results: 2023 年,澳大利亚估计有 219,800 名慢性乙型肝炎患者,其中 118,334 人 (53.8%) 在 2014 年至 2023 年期间接受了病毒载量检测或 治疗,其中只有 21.3% 的接受定期监测。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 该研究确定了慢性乙型肝炎护理方面的巨大差距,特别是在非 治疗 人群的持续监测方面,并强调了原住民和托雷斯海峡岛民等重点人群和出生地区之间的差异。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果强调,需要重新吸引失访的个体,并优先考虑公平地获得病毒载量监测和 治疗,以减少可预防的肝病和癌症负担。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究依赖于行政数据,这可能低估了真正的护理参与度,并且缺乏详细的临床或病毒学结果,限制了因果推断和对更广泛人群的普遍性。

analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 这项国家关联数据 队列研究 研究分析了澳大利亚国家健康保险系统中的乙型肝炎病毒载量检测记录和 抗病毒药物 治疗 记录,与移民、死亡和社会人口统计数据集相关联。
analysis_zh.methods: 使用慢性乙型肝炎患者人数的模型估计来评估 治疗 和病毒载量测试的采用情况,并根据分发的脚本评估测试频率和 治疗 依从性。

papers.title: Hepatocellular Carcinoma Risk Between Untreated Immune Tolerant Vs. Treated Immune Active Chronic Hepatitis B Patients.
papers.abstract: The risk of hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) between chronic hepatitis B (CHB) patients in the untreated immune tolerant (U-IT) vs. treated immune active (T-IA) phases is not clear, and most data are in Asian populations. We aim to evaluate long-term risks of cirrhosis, HCC, and overall mortality between U-IT vs. T-IA CHB patients among a national cohort of U.S. We conducted a propensity score weighted analysis of Veterans with CHB who met criteria for U-IT or T-IA from 1/1/2010 to 12/31/2021 (with follow-up through 12/31/2024). Incidence of cirrhosis, HCC, or death were compared between U-IT and T-IA groups. A total of 591 U-IT and 555 T-IA CHB patients were identified (mean age 56.4-57.5 years, 45%-50% non-Hispanic white, 37%-40% African American, 9%-10% Asian, 25%-29% concurrent diabetes, 35%-39% with FIB-4 > 3.25). Over a median follow up of 6.4 years (IQR 3.0-10.4), incidence of HCC was significantly lower in U-IT patients vs. T-IA patients (0.28 vs. 0.54 per 100 person-years; HR 0.52, 95% CI 0.32-0.83, p = 0.007). However, the risk of cirrhosis or all-cause mortality was similar between both T-IA and U-IT CHB patients. Among a predominantly non-Asian cohort of adults with CHB, we observed that HCC risk was lower in U-IT patients compared to T-IA patients. While this contrasts with some studies in Asian countries, these data do emphasize the importance of prioritizing and ensuring timely therapy for CHB patients in the IA phase. However, routine treatment in IT patients remains controversial and more data are needed to better understand long-term outcomes.

analysis.summary_en: This study compared hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) risk between untreated immune tolerant (U-IT) and treated immune active (T-IA) chronic hepatitis B (CHB) patients in a U.S. cohort of Veterans. Among a predominantly non-Asian cohort of adults with CHB, we observed that HCC risk was lower in U-IT patients compared to T-IA patients. While this contrasts with some studies in Asian countries, these data do emphasize the importance of prioritizing and ensuring timely therapy for CHB patients in the IA phase. However, routine treatment in IT patients remains controversial and more data are needed to better understand long-term outcomes.

analysis_zh.research_question_and_background: 慢性乙型肝炎 (CHB) 患者在未经治疗的免疫耐受 (U-IT) 与治疗的免疫活跃 (T-IA) 阶段发生肝细胞癌 (HCC) 的风险尚不清楚,并且大多数数据来自亚洲人群。
analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 我们对 2010 年 1 月 1 日至 2021 年 12 月 31 日期间符合 U-IT 或 T-IA 标准的慢性乙型肝炎退伍军人进行了倾向评分加权分析(随访至 2024 年 12 月 31 日)。总共确定了 591 名 U-IT 和 555 名 T-IA CHB 患者。
analysis_zh.methods: 比较 U-IT 组和 T-IA 组之间肝硬化、HCC 或死亡的 发病率。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 在主要为非亚裔的慢性乙型肝炎成人 队列研究 中,我们观察到与 T-IA 患者相比,U-IT 患者的 HCC 风险较低。虽然这与亚洲国家的一些研究形成鲜明对比,但这些数据确实强调了在 IA 阶段优先考虑并确保及时治疗 CHB 患者的重要性。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现强调了在免疫活跃期对慢性乙型肝炎患者进行及时治疗的必要性,尽管免疫耐受患者的常规 治疗 仍存在争议,并且需要更多数据来更好地了解长期结果。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究主要是在退伍军人中非亚裔 队列研究 中进行的,这可能会限制对其他人群的推广。尽管有倾向评分加权,但由于观察设计和潜在的残留混杂因素,证据强度中等。

papers.title: Diminished Hepatitis B Antibody Response in Pediatrics With Type 1 Diabetes; the Need for Revaccination Protocol: A Case-Control Study.
papers.abstract: BACKGROUND AND AIMS: Hepatitis B virus (HBV) infection is a significant chronic infection in pediatric patients. Vaccination induces production of anti-Hepatitis B surface antibodies, which serve as markers of protective immunity. Given the long-term risks of cirrhosis and hepatocellular carcinoma during adulthood, this study aimed to assess and compare seroprotection between children with type 1 diabetes mellitus (T1DM) and nondiabetic participants. METHODS: In this case-control study, 127 children with T1DM and 124 controls, all in a healthy immune state and fully vaccinated against HBV, were recruited from Shiraz University pediatric endocrinology clinics. Exclusion criteria included immunosuppression, incomplete vaccination, or hepatitis history in the child/family. Ethical approval was obtained from Shiraz University of Medical Sciences. Comparisons of sex, age, antibody titers, and diabetes indices used appropriate inferential tests; odds of inadequate antibody titers were assessed by logistic regression. RESULTS: Considering an antibody titer of 10 mIU/mL as adequate, the non-protection rate was 54.3% (95% CI: 45.3%-63.2%) in diabetic individuals and 28.2% (95% CI:20.5%-37.0%) in non-diabetics. In a multivariable model controlling for time from vaccination, time from vaccination (OR = 1.26, 95% CI: 1.06-1.49, p < 0.001), and diabetes status (OR = 2.34, 95% CI: 1.33-4.14, p = 0.002) contributed to inadequate antibody titers. Sex, glycemic control, and disease duration over 1 year had no significant effect. CONCLUSION: Children with type 1 Diabetes Mellitus exhibited lower anti-HBs antibody titers compared to their nondiabetic counterparts, with no association found with sex or glycemic control. The timing of vaccination and diabetes status should be considered when evaluating immune responses to HBV vaccination in children.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 乙型肝炎病毒 (HBV) 感染是儿科患者中一种重要的慢性感染。本研究旨在评估和比较 1 型糖尿病 (T1DM) 儿童和非糖尿病参与者之间的血清保护作用。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 在这项病例对照研究中,从设拉子大学儿科内分泌诊所招募了 127 名 T1DM 儿童和 124 名对照儿童,他们均处于健康的免疫状态,并完全接种了 HBV 疫苗。排除标准包括免疫抑制、疫苗接种 不完整或儿童/家庭有肝炎病史。
elements_zh.methods: 获得设拉子医科大学的伦理批准。使用适当的推理测试对性别、年龄、抗体滴度和糖尿病指数进行比较;通过逻辑回归评估抗体滴度不足的几率。
elements_zh.main_results: 考虑到抗体滴度为 10 mIU/mL 就足够了,糖尿病患者的无保护率为 54.3%(95% CI:45.3%-63.2%),非糖尿病患者的无保护率为 28.2%(95% CI:20.5%-37.0%)。性别、血糖控制和病程超过1年没有显着影响。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 与非糖尿病儿童相比,1 型糖尿病儿童表现出较低的抗 HBs 抗体滴度,且与性别或血糖控制没有关联。在儿童中评估 免疫应答 与 HBV 疫苗接种 时,应考虑 免疫应答 的时机和糖尿病状况。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果表明,需要为 1 型糖尿病儿童制定重新接种疫苗方案,以确保充分预防 HBV。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究的局限性在于其依赖抗体滴度作为保护性免疫的标志,并且可能存在混杂因素。由于研究设计和病例对照方法的使用,证据强度适中。

papers.title: The immunoecology of occult hepatitis B virus infection: genetic remodeling and the immune-mediated microcosm
papers.abstract: Occult hepatitis B infection (OBI) is characterized by the persistence of replication-competent hepatitis B virus (HBV) DNA in the absence of detectable hepatitis B surface antigen (HBsAg). Although typically clinically silent, OBI remains associated with transfusion-transmitted infection, viral reactivation during immunosuppression, and an increased risk of hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC). The mechanisms underlying this persistent low-replicative state remain incompletely understood. In this review, we summarize current evidence supporting the concept that OBI is maintained through dynamic interactions among viral genetic adaptation, host genetic and epigenetic regulation, and the intrahepatic immune microenvironment. Building upon these observations, we propose the immune-mediated microcosm as a conceptual framework describing how these processes may interact to sustain long-term immune equilibrium. analysis.scope_and_question: This review focuses on occult hepatitis B virus (HBV) infection (OBI), characterized by the persistence of replication-competent HBV DNA without detectable hepatitis B surface antigen (HBsAg). The central question is to understand the mechanisms underlying this persistent low-replicative state through interactions among viral genetic adaptation, host genetic and epigenetic regulation, and the intrahepatic immune microenvironment.
analysis.evidence_base_and_review_method: The review is a narrative synthesis summarizing current evidence on OBI. It does not report specific databases, search dates, eligibility criteria, or study counts. The approach involves proposing a conceptual framework (immune-mediated microcosm) based on existing observations and distinguishing mechanisms supported by direct evidence in OBI from those inferred from related conditions or experimental models.
analysis.consensus_and_key_conclusions: The review concludes that OBI is maintained through dynamic interactions among viral genetic adaptation, host genetic and epigenetic regulation, and the intrahepatic immune microenvironment. It proposes the immune-mediated microcosm as a framework to describe how these processes interact to sustain long-term immune equilibrium. Key areas of agreement include the role of coordinated viral and host genetic remodeling, immunometabolic regulation, and immune checkpoint signaling in OBI pathogenesis.
analysis.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: The review highlights that the mechanisms underlying OBI remain incompletely understood. It emphasizes the need to distinguish between mechanisms directly supported by evidence in OBI and those inferred from chronic hepatitis B, hepatocellular carcinoma, or experimental models. Current evidential limitations include the lack of direct validation in human OBI for many proposed mechanisms, and the framework is presented as a facilitator for investigation rather than a definitive model.
analysis.research_and_practice_implications: The implications of the framework include facilitating biomarker discovery, risk stratification, and therapeutic development for OBI. The review identifies priorities for future research into OBI pathogenesis, emphasizing the need for direct validation in human OBI. The framework is intended to generate experimentally testable hypotheses and guide mechanistic investigation rather than providing definitive guidance.

elements_zh.scope_and_question: 本综述重点关注隐匿性 乙型肝炎病毒 (HBV) 感染 (OBI),其特征是具有复制能力的 HBV DNA 持续存在,但未检测到乙型肝炎表面抗原 (HBsAg)。核心问题是通过病毒遗传适应、宿主 遗传和表观遗传调控以及肝内免疫微环境之间的相互作用来了解这种持续低复制状态的机制。
elements_zh.evidence_base_and_review_method: 该评论是对 OBI 现有证据的叙述性综合。它不报告具体的数据库、检索日期、资格标准或研究计数。该方法包括根据现有观察提出一个概念框架(免疫介导的微观世界),并将 OBI 中直接证据支持的机制与从相关条件或实验模型推断的机制区分开来。
elements_zh.consensus_and_key_conclusions: 该综述得出的结论是,OBI 是通过病毒遗传适应、宿主 遗传和表观遗传调控以及肝内免疫微环境之间的动态相互作用来维持的。它提出免疫介导的微观世界作为一个框架来描述这些过程如何相互作用以维持长期的免疫平衡。达成一致的关键领域包括协调病毒和 宿主 遗传重塑、免疫代谢调节和 OBI 发病机制 中免疫检查点信号传导的作用。
elements_zh.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: 审查强调,OBI 的潜在机制仍未完全被了解。它强调需要区分 OBI 证据直接支持的机制和从 慢性乙型肝炎、肝细胞癌或实验模型推断的机制。目前的证据局限性包括许多提出的机制缺乏人类 OBI 的直接验证,并且该框架是作为调查的促进者而不是确定的模型提出的。
elements_zh.research_and_practice_implications: 该框架的意义包括促进 OBI 的生物标志物发现、风险分层和治疗开发。该审查确定了 OBI 发病机制 未来研究的优先事项,强调需要在人类 OBI 中进行直接验证。该框架旨在生成可通过实验检验的假设并指导机制研究,而不是提供明确的指导。

analysis_zh.scope_and_question: 本综述重点关注隐匿性 乙型肝炎病毒 (HBV) 感染 (OBI),其特征是具有复制能力的 HBV DNA 持续存在,但未检测到乙型肝炎表面抗原 (HBsAg)。核心问题是通过病毒遗传适应、宿主 遗传和表观遗传调控以及肝内免疫微环境之间的相互作用来了解这种持续低复制状态的机制。
analysis_zh.evidence_base_and_review_method: 该评论是对 OBI 现有证据的叙述性综合。它不报告具体的数据库、检索日期、资格标准或研究计数。该方法包括根据现有观察提出一个概念框架(免疫介导的微观世界),并将 OBI 中直接证据支持的机制与从相关条件或实验模型推断的机制区分开来。
analysis_zh.consensus_and_key_conclusions: 该综述得出的结论是,OBI 是通过病毒遗传适应、宿主 遗传和表观遗传调控以及肝内免疫微环境之间的动态相互作用来维持的。它提出免疫介导的微观世界作为一个框架来描述这些过程如何相互作用以维持长期的免疫平衡。达成一致的关键领域包括协调病毒和 宿主 遗传重塑、免疫代谢调节和 OBI 发病机制 中免疫检查点信号传导的作用。
analysis_zh.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: 审查强调,OBI 的潜在机制仍未完全被了解。它强调需要区分 OBI 证据直接支持的机制和从 慢性乙型肝炎、肝细胞癌或实验模型推断的机制。目前的证据局限性包括许多提出的机制缺乏人类 OBI 的直接验证,并且该框架是作为调查的促进者而不是确定的模型提出的。
analysis_zh.research_and_practice_implications: 该框架的意义包括促进 OBI 的生物标志物发现、风险分层和治疗开发。该审查确定了 OBI 发病机制 未来研究的优先事项,强调需要在人类 OBI 中进行直接验证。该框架旨在生成可通过实验检验的假设并指导机制研究,而不是提供明确的指导。

papers.title: High Rates of Advanced Chronic Liver Disease in Patients With Chronic Hepatitis D Virus Infection in Uzbekistan.
papers.abstract: BACKGROUND AND AIMS: Chronic hepatitis B virus (HBV) infection is endemic in Uzbekistan. Previous data showed a high prevalence of anti-hepatitis D virus (HDV) antibodies in HBsAg-positive individuals. Limited data are available on disease severity, treatment availability and hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) prevalence in patients with chronic HDV infection in Uzbekistan. METHODS: The Scientific Research Institute of Virology (SRIoV) is the leading medical and scientific reference centre for viral hepatitis in Uzbekistan. In this retrospective study, epidemiological, clinical and laboratory data were collected and analysed from all HBsAg-positive patients presenting to the SRIoV between June 2023 and May 2024. Data from HDV-coinfected and HBV-monoinfected patients were compared. RESULTS: Data of 1393 individual patients were included. HDV coinfection was more prevalent than HBV-monoinfection (73.9% [n = 1030/1393]) vs. 26.1% [n = 363/1393]. HDV-infected patients were significantly younger (41.9 vs. 45.4, p upper limit of normal. The HCC detection rate was low in both patient groups due to insufficient screening measures (HDV: n = 7/1030, HBV: n = 11/363). CONCLUSIONS: In this retrospective cohort of 1393 individual patients, HDV coinfection exceeds HBV monoinfection in prevalence and disease severity. Most HDV-infected patients present with advanced liver disease and currently lack access to HDV-directed therapy.
papers.journal: Liver international : official journal of the International Association for the Study of the Liver

analysis.summary_en: This retrospective study from Uzbekistan investigated the prevalence and severity of chronic hepatitis D virus (HDV) infection in patients with chronic hepatitis B virus (HBV) infection. Among 1393 HBsAg-positive patients, HDV coinfection was more prevalent (73.9%) than HBV monoinfection (26.1%). HDV-infected patients were younger but had more advanced liver disease, with higher rates of cirrhosis (41.3% vs. 25.3%) and elevated ALT levels (58.6% vs. 43.8%). The study highlights the urgent need for improved screening and treatment access for HDV-infected patients to address the high burden of advanced liver disease and reduce HCC risk.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 慢性乙型肝炎 病毒 (HBV) 感染在乌兹别克斯坦流行,之前的数据显示 HBsAg 阳性个体的抗丁型肝炎病毒 (HDV) 抗体 患病率 较高,但乌兹别克斯坦慢性 HDV 感染患者的疾病严重程度、治疗 可用性和肝细胞癌 (HCC) 患病率 的数据有限。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 这项回顾性研究是在乌兹别克斯坦病毒学科学研究所 (SRIOV) 进行的,该研究所是乌兹别克斯坦领先的病毒性肝炎医学和科学参考中心,收集并分析了 2023 年 6 月至 2024 年 5 月期间就诊于 SRIoV 的所有 HBsAg 阳性患者的流行病学、临床和实验室数据。
elements_zh.methods: 对 HDV 合并感染和 HBV 单一感染患者的数据进行了比较,分析中总共纳入了 1393 名患者。

elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者解释说,在 患病率 和疾病严重程度方面,HDV 合并感染超过 HBV 单一感染,并且大多数 HDV 感染患者出现晚期肝病,目前缺乏针对 HDV 的治疗。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果强调,乌兹别克斯坦迫切需要改进 HDV 感染患者的筛查和 治疗 的获取,以解决晚期肝病的沉重负担并降低 HCC 风险。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究因其回顾性设计和由于筛查措施不足而导致两个患者组的 HCC 检出率较低而受到限制,但大样本量和全面的数据收集提供了中等的证据强度。
