papers.title: A highly sensitive and specific fluorescent immunoassay for hepatitis B envelope antigen detection using AIE-encoded nanobioprobes.
papers.abstract: Developing highly sensitive, efficient, stable, and low-cost viral antigen detection strategies suitable for primary healthcare settings is of great significance for the early diagnosis and treatment of viral infections. Herein, we report a highly efficient fluorescent immunoassay strategy for the detection of hepatitis B envelope antigen (HBeAg) based on aggregation-induced emission (AIE) molecule-encoded fluorescent nanospheres. Three AIE luminogens (TPE-Br4, TPE-O2, and TPE-O3) were encapsulated into carboxyl-functionalized nanospheres via an ultrasonic swelling method, yielding uniform and well-dispersed multicolor fluorescent nanospheres. Among them, the red-emitting nanospheres, exhibiting superior photostability, were selected as signal output units. Anti-hepatitis B envelope antibodies were subsequently conjugated onto their surfaces to construct fluorescent nanobioprobes. By integrating these nanobioprobes with a sandwich-type enzyme-linked immunosorbent assay, specific capture and recognition of HBeAg were successfully achieved. The proposed method demonstrated a linear detection range of 0.01-1 ng mL -1 and an ultra-low limit of detection (LOD) of 9 pg mL -1 . In addition, it exhibited excellent specificity and robust anti-interference performance in spiked fresh mouse serum samples. Overall, this work presents a sensitive, convenient, and cost-effective sensing platform for HBeAg detection, showing great potential for rapid and on-site screening of viral antigens in clinical applications.

papers.abstract_zh: 开发适合基层医疗机构的高灵敏、高效、稳定、低成本的病毒抗原检测策略对于病毒感染的早期诊断和治疗具有重要意义。在此,我们报告了一种基于聚集诱导发射(AIE)分子编码荧光纳米球的高效荧光免疫分析策略,用于检测乙型肝炎包膜抗原(HBeAg)。通过超声溶胀法将三种AIE发光体(TPE-Br4、TPE-O2和TPE-O3)封装到羧基功能化的纳米球中,产生均匀且分散良好的多色荧光纳米球。其中,具有优异光稳定性的发红光纳米球被选为信号输出单元。随后将抗乙型肝炎包膜抗体缀合到其表面以构建荧光纳米生物探针。通过将这些纳米生物探针与夹心型酶联免疫吸附测定相结合,成功实现了 HBeAg 的特异性捕获和识别。该方法的线性检测范围为0.01-1 ng mL -1,超低检测限(LOD)为9 pg mL -1。此外,它在加标的新鲜小鼠血清样品中表现出优异的特异性和强大的抗干扰性能。总体而言,这项工作为 HBeAg 检测提供了一个灵敏、方便且经济高效的传感平台,在临床应用中显示出快速现场筛选病毒抗原的巨大潜力。

analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究报告了使用聚集诱导发射(AIE)分子编码的荧光纳米球检测乙型肝炎包膜抗原(HBeAg)的荧光免疫分析策略的开发。

analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果表明,该平台可以通过在初级医疗机构中实现快速且可访问的抗原检测来改善 诊断 和 治疗 感染的早期 诊断 和 治疗 感染。

papers.title: Exploring the role of the ABO blood group types in hepatitis B virus infection: a systematic review
papers.abstract: Introduction ABO blood groups have been associated with several disorders, including cancer, peptic ulcers, coagulopathy and infections. However, the mechanism of this association is unclear. This review examines the role ABO blood groups play in HBV infection. Methods A systematic search of seven electronic databases was conducted using the Population, Intervention/Exposure, Comparator, Outcome framework, including all studies published between 1974 and 2024. The review is registered in PROSPERO (ID: CRD420251243615). Results Thirty-five articles from seventeen countries across four continents were selected for review. Twelve of these demonstrated significant associations between ABO blood groups and HBV infection, with the majority investigating healthy blood donors. Disease progression to hepatic fibrosis and cirrhosis in individuals with chronic hepatitis B infection was associated with blood groups O and A. Conclusions Variable evidence linking ABO blood groups to HBV highlights the role of other factors. Links between ABO blood groups and HBV genotypes remain unclear.

analysis.scope_and_question: The review investigates whether human ABO blood group types influence susceptibility to or progression of hepatitis B virus (HBV) infection in humans, focusing on the central question of whether ABO blood group is associated with HBV infection or disease outcomes.
analysis.evidence_base_and_review_method: This is a systematic review registered in PROSPERO (CRD420251243615) that searched seven electronic databases for studies published between 1974 and 2024 using the Population, Intervention/Exposure, Comparator, Outcome framework. Thirty-five articles from seventeen countries across four continents were selected.
analysis.consensus_and_key_conclusions: Twelve studies reported significant associations between ABO blood groups and HBV infection, with most studies conducted among healthy blood donors. Disease progression to hepatic fibrosis and cirrhosis in chronic hepatitis B was associated with blood groups O and A.
analysis.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: The review highlights variable evidence linking ABO blood groups to HBV infection and notes that links between ABO blood groups and HBV genotypes remain unclear. The mechanism underlying any association is not established.
analysis.research_and_practice_implications: Further research is needed to clarify the biological mechanisms linking ABO blood groups to HBV infection and disease progression, particularly regarding HBV genotypes and long-term outcomes such as fibrosis and cirrhosis.

analysis.summary_en: This systematic review examines whether ABO blood group types influence hepatitis B virus (HBV) infection and disease progression in humans. Using a registered PROSPERO protocol, the review searched seven databases for studies from 1974 to 2024 and included 35 articles from 17 countries. Twelve studies reported significant associations between ABO blood groups and HBV infection, predominantly in healthy blood donors. Associations were also noted between blood groups O and A and progression to hepatic fibrosis and cirrhosis in chronic hepatitis B. However, the review emphasizes variable evidence and unresolved questions about mechanisms and links to HBV genotypes. The findings underscore the need for further research to clarify biological pathways and inform risk stratification and clinical management.

elements_zh.evidence_base_and_review_method: 这是在 PROSPERO (CRD420251243615) 中注册的一项系统综述,使用人口、干预/暴露、比较器、结果框架检索了 7 个电子数据库,查找 1974 年至 2024 年间发表的研究。来自四大洲 17 个国家的 35 篇文章入选。
elements_zh.consensus_and_key_conclusions: 十二项研究报告了 ABO 血型与 HBV 感染之间的显着关联,其中大多数研究是在健康献血者中进行的。慢性乙型肝炎 疾病进展为肝纤维化和肝硬化与 O 型和 A 型血相关。
elements_zh.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: 该综述强调了将 ABO 血型与 HBV 感染联系起来的不同证据,并指出 ABO 血型与 HBV 基因型之间的联系仍不清楚。任何关联背后的机制尚未建立。
elements_zh.research_and_practice_implications: 需要进一步的研究来阐明 ABO 血型与 HBV 感染和疾病进展之间的生物学机制,特别是关于 HBV 基因型和纤维化和肝硬化等长期结果。

papers.title: Primary Intraparotid Lymph Node Kaposi Sarcoma in an HIV-negative Patient with Chronic Hepatitis B Receiving Antiviral Therapy: A Rare Case Report
papers.abstract: Abstract Background : Kaposi sarcoma (KS) is a vascular neoplasm associated with human herpesvirus-8 (HHV-8) and is most commonly encountered in patients with HIV infection or other forms of immunosuppression. Primary involvement of an intraparotid lymph node is exceptionally rare, particularly in HIV-negative individuals. We report an unusual case of isolated intraparotid nodal KS in a patient with chronic hepatitis B receiving antiviral therapy. Case Presentation: A 58-year-old HIV-negative man with chronic hepatitis B receiving antiviral therapy presented with a gradually enlarging left parotid mass of 3–4 months’ duration. Contrast-enhanced computed tomography demonstrated a well-defined enhancing lesion within the superficial lobe of the parotid gland. The patient underwent superficial parotidectomy with preservation of the facial nerve. Histopathological examination, supported by positive HHV-8 immunohistochemistry, confirmed Kaposi sarcoma arising in an intraparotid lymph node. Postoperative whole-body PET/CT, performed on two separate occasions, showed no evidence of residual tumor or systemic disease. Conclusion: This case highlights an exceptionally rare presentation of Kaposi sarcoma as an isolated intraparotid lymph node lesion in an HIV-negative patient with concomitant chronic hepatitis B receiving antiviral therapy. It expands the limited literature on this uncommon entity and emphasizes that Kaposi sarcoma should be considered in the differential diagnosis of atypical parotid masses, even in the absence of HIV infection or disseminated disease.

papers.abstract_zh: 摘要背景:卡波西肉瘤 (KS) 是一种与人疱疹病毒 8 (HHV-8) 相关的血管肿瘤,最常见于 HIV 感染或其他形式的免疫抑制患者。原发性腮腺内淋巴结受累极为罕见,特别是在 HIV 阴性个体中。我们报告了一名接受 抗病毒药物 治疗的 慢性乙型肝炎 患者发生孤立性腮腺内淋巴结 KS 的罕见病例。病例介绍:一名患有 慢性乙型肝炎 的 58 岁 HIV 阴性男性接受 抗病毒药物 治疗,出现左腮腺肿块逐渐增大,持续 3-4 个月。对比增强计算机断层扫描显示腮腺浅叶内有明确的增强病变。患者接受了腮腺浅表切除术,保留了面神经。组织病理学检查,在 HHV-8 免疫组织化学阳性的支持下,证实卡波西肉瘤起源于腮腺内淋巴结。两次独立进行的术后全身 PET/CT 未显示残留肿瘤或全身性疾病的证据。结论:该病例突出显示,在同时接受 抗病毒药物 治疗的 HIV 阴性患者中,卡波西肉瘤表现为孤立性腮腺内淋巴结病变,且同时接受 慢性乙型肝炎 治疗。它扩展了关于这种罕见实体的有限文献,并强调即使在没有 HIV 感染或播散性疾病的情况下,在非典型腮腺肿块的鉴别 诊断 中也应考虑卡波西肉瘤。

papers.title: Frequency of Hepatitis B and Hepatitis C Infections Among Patients With Chronic Kidney Disease: A Retrospective Data-Based Study From Lahore, Pakistan
papers.abstract: Background and objective Chronic hepatitis B virus (HBV) and chronic hepatitis C virus (HCV) infections are significant global public health challenges, affecting millions of individuals worldwide and contributing substantially to morbidity and mortality due to chronic liver disease and its complications. In Pakistan, the burden of viral hepatitis remains considerable, with HBV and HCV infections continuing to affect vulnerable populations and placing an additional healthcare burden on patients with chronic diseases, including chronic kidney disease (CKD). This study aimed to determine the frequency of both HBV and HCV infections separately among CKD patients and to evaluate their relationship with demographic and clinical factors in a local Pakistani population. Methods This retrospective data-based study was conducted at Chaudhary Muhammad Akram Teaching and Research Hospital (Lahore, PAK) and included 317 medical records of CKD patients aged ≥18 years who presented to the Department of Medicine and Nephrology for dialysis and ICU admission from January to December 2025. Incomplete medical records, patients with acute kidney injury, and records missing hepatitis serologies were excluded. A structured pro forma was used to extract demographic characteristics, CKD-related variables, and laboratory parameters including HBsAg and anti-HCV antibodies from patient medical records. Data were analyzed using SPSS Statistics version 23 (IBM Corp., Armonk, NY, USA). Results Of the 317 CKD patients, 185 (58.4%) were male, and 184 (58.0%) resided in urban areas. Mean CKD duration was 2.9±2.8 years, with 185 (58.4%) having CKD for ≥2 years and 246 (77.6%) with stage 5 CKD. Hypertension was present in 271 (85.5%), diabetes in 171 (53.9%), and cardiovascular disease in 72 (22.7%). History of blood transfusion was reported in 140 (44.2%), while 214 (67.5%) had a history of dialysis. The mean hemoglobin (Hb) was 9.3±1.5 g/dL, with 247 (77.9%) having Hb>8 g/dL. Hepatitis B surface antigen (HBsAg) positivity was detected in 13 (4.1%) and anti-HCV in 131 (41.3%). Five (1.5%) had both HBsAg and anti-HCV positivity. Chi-square analysis revealed significantly associated anti-HCV positivity with the male gender (p<0.001), urban residence (p=0.038), CKD duration ≥2 years (p=0.027), advanced CKD stage (p<0.001), cardiovascular disease (p=0.049), blood transfusion history (p<0.001), and dialysis history (p<0.001). Binary logistic regression analysis demonstrated male gender (OR=0.483, 95% CI: 0.277-0.839; p=0.010), urban residence (OR=0.520, 95% CI: 0.305-0.887; p=0.016), positive history of blood transfusion (OR=0.348, 95% CI: 0.183-0.660; p=0.001), and dialysis history (OR=0.211, 95% CI: 0.091-0.488; p<0.001) to be predictors of anti-HCV positivity. Fisher's exact test demonstrated a significant association of HBsAg with the female gender (p=0.047) and diabetes (p<0.001). Regression analysis was not applied for HBsAg due to the limited number of participants with HBV positivity. Conclusion Hepatitis C virus was highly prevalent in CKD patients; HBV remained comparatively uncommon. This emphasizes the need for routine screening among CKD patients, especially those undergoing dialysis or receiving blood transfusions. Strengthening infection-control measures, ensuring safe transfusion practices, promoting HBV vaccination, and providing timely antiviral management may reduce the burden of viral hepatitis and improve clinical outcomes in this high-risk population.

analysis.summary_en: This retrospective study investigated the frequency of hepatitis B and C infections among 317 chronic kidney disease (CKD) patients in Lahore, Pakistan. The study found that hepatitis C virus (HCV) was highly prevalent, with 41.3% of patients testing positive for anti-HCV antibodies, while hepatitis B virus (HBV) was less common, with only 4.1% testing positive for HBsAg. Significant associations were found between HCV positivity and male gender, urban residence, longer CKD duration, advanced CKD stage, cardiovascular disease, blood transfusion history, and dialysis history. The authors emphasize the need for routine screening of CKD patients, particularly those undergoing dialysis or receiving blood transfusions, and recommend strengthening infection-control measures, safe transfusion practices, HBV vaccination, and timely antiviral management to reduce the burden of viral hepatitis in this high-risk population.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 慢性乙型肝炎 病毒 (HBV) 和慢性丙型肝炎病毒 (HCV) 感染是全球重大的公共卫生挑战,影响着全世界数百万人,并大大增加了慢性肝病及其并发症导致的发病率和 死亡率。本研究旨在分别确定 CKD 患者中 HBV 和 HCV 感染的频率,并评估其与巴基斯坦当地人口的人口和临床因素的关系。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 这项基于数据的回顾性研究是在 Chaudhary Muhammad Akram 教学研究医院(拉合尔,PAK)进行的,纳入了 2025 年 1 月至 12 月到医学和肾脏病科进行透析和入住 ICU 的 317 份 18 岁以上 CKD 患者的医疗记录。
elements_zh.methods: 使用结构化形式从患者病历中提取人口特征、CKD 相关变量和实验室参数,包括 HBsAg 和抗 HCV 抗体。使用 SPSS Statistics 版本 23(IBM Corp.,Armonk,NY,USA)分析数据。
elements_zh.main_results: 13 例 (4.1%) 检测出乙型肝炎表面抗原 (HBsAg) 阳性,131 例 (41.3%) 检测出抗 HCV 阳性。五人 (1.5%) HBsAg 和抗 HCV 均呈阳性。卡方分析显示,抗-HCV 阳性与男性(p<0.001)、城市居住(p=0.038)、CKD 病程≥2 年(p=0.027)、晚期 CKD 分期(p<0.001)、心血管疾病(p=0.049)、输血史(p<0.001)和透析史(p<0.001)显着相关。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 丙型肝炎病毒在 CKD 患者中非常流行;乙型肝炎病毒仍然相对不常见。这强调了对 CKD 患者进行常规筛查的必要性,特别是那些接受透析或接受输血的患者。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 加强感染控制措施、确保安全输血实践、推广 HBV 疫苗接种 并提供及时的 抗病毒药物 管理可能会减轻病毒性肝炎的负担并改善这一高危人群的临床结果。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 由于 HBV 阳性的参与者数量有限,因此未对 HBsAg 进行回归分析。由于回顾性设计和未完全解决潜在的混杂因素,证据强度中等。

papers.title: Clinically detected hepatitis B virus reactivation in HBsAg-negative, anti-HBc-positive breast cancer patients receiving systemic therapy without antiviral prophylaxis: a two-centre descriptive cohort and nested case study
papers.abstract: Background Hepatitis B virus (HBV) reactivation is a recognised complication in HBsAg-negative, anti-HBc-positive patients receiving cytotoxic cancer therapy. Guidelines place anti-HBc-positive patients exposed to anthracyclines in a moderate-risk band warranting on-treatment monitoring or selective prophylaxis, yet real-world data from non-prophylaxis breast cancer practice, where serial HBV DNA surveillance is often incomplete, remain scarce. Methods We retrospectively studied HBsAg-negative, anti-HBc-positive breast cancer patients treated with systemic therapy between 2018 and 2024 at two centres in Turkey, none of whom received antiviral prophylaxis. We extracted demographic, oncological and virological data, including baseline anti-HBs titres and all available HBV DNA and alanine aminotransferase (ALT) results, and we quantified the completeness of virological surveillance. Because on-treatment HBV DNA was tested only when hepatitis was clinically suspected, the outcome captured was clinically detected reactivation; the study therefore describes surveillance quality rather than estimating true incidence. With a single event, analyses were kept descriptive. Results Among 139 patients (mean age 60.1 years), 89.2% were anti-HBs-positive and 65.5% received anthracyclines. Baseline HBV DNA was documented in all patients, but serial on-treatment monitoring was not. One clinically overt reactivation occurred (0.7%; 95% CI 0.02%–3.94%) in an anti-HBs-negative woman receiving doxorubicin–cyclophosphamide, presenting as icteric hepatitis at month 4 and responding to entecavir. Since subclinical events would have escaped detection, this figure is best read as a lower bound rather than a true incidence. Conclusions The single reactivation we detected arose in the patient profile that the guidelines flag as moderate-risk—absent anti-HBs together with anthracycline exposure. These observations are consistent with, but do not establish, a risk-adapted approach, given one event and incomplete surveillance. Prospective studies using standardised serial HBV DNA monitoring are needed to estimate true reactivation incidence in this population.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigated HBV reactivation in HBsAg-negative, anti-HBc-positive breast cancer patients without antiviral prophylaxis. The authors call for prospective studies with standardised monitoring to accurately assess reactivation risk in this population.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 乙型肝炎病毒 (HBV) 再激活是接受细胞毒性癌症治疗的 HBsAg 阴性、抗 HBc 阳性患者的公认并发症,但来自不完整连续 HBV DNA 监测 的非预防性乳腺癌实践的真实世界数据仍然很少。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 我们回顾性研究了 2018 年至 2024 年间在土耳其两个中心接受全身治疗的 HBsAg 阴性、抗 HBc 阳性乳腺癌患者,其中没有人接受 抗病毒药物 预防。
elements_zh.methods: 我们提取了人口统计学、肿瘤学和病毒学数据,包括基线抗 HBs 滴度以及所有可用的 HBV DNA 和丙氨酸转氨酶 (ALT) 结果,并量化了病毒学 监测 的完整性。
elements_zh.main_results: 139 名患者(平均年龄 60.1 岁)中,89.2% 为抗 HBs 阳性,65.5% 接受蒽环类药物治疗;所有患者均记录了基线 HBV DNA,但未记录 治疗 连续监测。一位接受阿霉素-环磷酰胺治疗的抗 HBs 阴性女性发生了一次临床上明显的再激活(0.7%;95% CI 0.02%–3.94%),在第 4 个月表现为黄疸型肝炎,并对恩替卡韦有反应。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 在患者资料中检测到的单次再激活被指南标记为中等风险——缺乏抗-HBs 以及蒽环类药物暴露。考虑到一个事件和不完整的 监测,这些观察结果与风险适应方法一致,但并未建立。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 需要使用标准化连续 HBV DNA 监测的前瞻性研究来估计该人群中真正的再激活 发病率,因为由于亚临床事件逃脱了检测,报告的数字最好解读为下限而不是真正的 发病率。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究的证据强度受到单一事件和不完整的 发病率 的限制,这阻碍了对真实 发病率 的估计,并且可能错过了亚临床再激活,从而导致描述性分析而不是推理性分析。

Conclusions The single reactivation we detected arose in the patient profile that the guidelines flag as moderate-risk—absent anti-HBs together with anthracycline exposure. These observations are consistent with, but do not establish, a risk-adapted approach, given one event and incomplete surveillance. Prospective studies using standardised serial HBV DNA monitoring are needed to estimate true reactivation incidence in this population.

papers.title: Association of the STAT3 rs1053004 Polymorphism With Hepatocellular Carcinoma in Iraqi Patients With Hepatitis B.
papers.abstract: INTRODUCTION: HCC is still one of the main causes of cancer-related fatalities despite years of intensive attempts to prevent it. One known risk factor is a persistent hepatitis B virus (HBV) infection. Previous studies have indicated a contribution of the STAT3 signaling pathway to carcinogenesis through inflammation mechanisms. In this study, we tried to explore the correlation between STAT3 rs1053004 polymorphism and HCC occurrence in people with HBV infection in Iraq. METHODS: A case-control approach was applied with the inclusion of 80 patients with HCC due to HBV infection, 80 patients with CHB, and 80 healthy controls. The study was based on genotyping of the STAT3 rs1053004 polymorphism by a TaqMan SNP genotyping assay. Multivariate logistic regression analysis was used to assess the genetic association with disease risk, adjusting for potential confounding factors. RESULTS: The three groups under study had significantly different genotype and allele distributions (p < 0.001). The HCC group had more T alleles than the other groups. Additionally, patients with the TT genotype had a greater risk of HCC (adjusted odds ratio [AOR] = 4.26; 95%confidence interval [CI] = 1.89-9.62; p < 0.001), and this impact was observed in patients with cirrhosis, high serum HBV DNA levels, and negative HBeAg status. CONCLUSION: STAT3 rs1053004 polymorphism plays a significant role in the development of HCC risk in people with HBV infection.

analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者解释说,STAT3 rs1053004 多态性在 HBV 感染者发生 HCC 风险的过程中发挥着重要作用,凸显了其作为遗传标记的潜力。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现可能为 HBV 感染人群(尤其是高危亚组)的 HCC 风险基因筛查提供信息,并可以指导个性化 监测 策略。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究仅限于伊拉克人群,由于病例对照设计和未完全解决潜在的混杂因素,证据强度中等。

papers.title: Using Inflammation as a Framework to Assess Hepatitis B Vaccine Immunity 2259206
papers.abstract: Abstract Introduction Infection with hepatitis B virus (HBV) remains a major global health concern despite being vaccine-preventable for nearly four decades. Although vaccination has significantly reduced disease burden, a subset of individuals fails to develop adequate protection and are classified as non-responders. Methods A longitudinal study evaluated hepatitis B vaccine responses in individuals with or without prior vaccination. Participants received either a 3-dose alum-adjuvanted or 2-dose CpG-adjuvanted vaccine, with a subset receiving a booster. ELISA analyzed blood samples collected on days 1, 8, and 30 to quantify anti-HBs titers, classified as high (≥50 mIU/mL), moderate (10—50 mIU/mL), or low (≤10 mIU/mL). Antibody avidity was measured using a modified ELISA with a chaotropic agent to assess binding strength. Results Age significantly affected vaccine responses. In the booster group, participants under 50 had higher baseline titers, while in the de novo group, younger individuals showed stronger early responses though final titers were similar across ages. Among hypertensive participants, older adults showed slower but steady antibody increases, surpassing younger participants by week 4. Avidity remained stable across both vaccine groups, indicating that prior vaccination increased antibody quantity but not binding strength, which plateaued early. Conclusion Immune recall among previously vaccinated individuals was variable. Although boosters produced a faster antibody rise, a higher proportion of non-responders suggests that prior vaccination does not always ensure lasting protection. Hypertension also shaped vaccine response: while hypertensive individuals achieved early seroconversion, their antibody levels plateaued at lower magnitudes, suggesting impaired immune sustainment possibly linked to vascular inflammation or endothelial dysfunction.Overall, these findings highlight the need for personalized vaccination strategies for individuals with hypertension or advanced age. analysis.summary_en: This study investigated hepatitis B vaccine responses in individuals with or without prior vaccination, comparing alum-adjuvanted and CpG-adjuvanted vaccines. Age significantly influenced responses: younger participants in the booster group had higher baseline titers, while in the de novo group, younger individuals showed stronger early responses. Hypertensive older adults had slower but steady antibody increases, surpassing younger participants by week 4. Antibody avidity remained stable, indicating prior vaccination increased quantity but not binding strength. The findings reveal variable immune recall, with boosters providing faster antibody rises but more non-responders, and hypertension leading to lower plateaued antibody levels. These results emphasize the need for personalized vaccination strategies for individuals with hypertension or advanced age.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 尽管 疫苗 可以预防近四十年,但 乙型肝炎病毒 (HBV) 感染仍然是全球主要的健康问题。尽管 疫苗接种 显着降低了疾病负担,但仍有一部分人未能形成足够的保护,并被归类为无反应者。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 一项纵向研究评估了先前有或没有 疫苗接种 的个体的乙型肝炎 疫苗 反应。参与者接受了 3 剂明矾佐剂或 2 剂 CpG 佐剂 疫苗,其中一部分接受了加强剂。
elements_zh.methods: ELISA 分析了第 1、8 和 30 天收集的血液样本,以量化抗 HBs 滴度,分为高 (≥50 mIU/mL)、中 (10-50 mIU/mL) 或低 (≤10 mIU/mL)。使用改良的 ELISA 和离液剂来测量抗体亲合力,以评估结合强度。
elements_zh.main_results: 年龄显着影响 疫苗 反应。在加强组中,50 岁以下的参与者具有较高的基线滴度,而在从头组中,较年轻的个体表现出更强的早期反应,尽管不同年龄段的最终滴度相似。在高血压参与者中,老年人表现出较慢但稳定的抗体增加,在第 4 周超过年轻参与者。两个 疫苗 组的亲合力保持稳定,表明先前的 疫苗 增加了抗体数量,但没有增加结合强度,并在早期达到稳定水平。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 先前接种过疫苗的个体的免疫记忆是可变的。尽管加强剂产生了更快的抗体上升,但无反应者比例较高,这表明之前的 疫苗接种 并不总是能确保持久的保护。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 高血压也塑造了 疫苗 反应:虽然高血压个体实现了早期血清转化,但他们的抗体水平稳定在较低水平,表明免疫维持受损可能与血管炎症或内皮功能障碍有关。总体而言,这些发现强调了针对高血压或高龄患者制定个性化 疫苗接种 策略的必要性。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 所提供的证据并未报告具体的局限性或证据的强度。该研究得到了美国国立卫生研究院国家过敏和传染病研究所的支持,奖项编号为 AI158617,并得到了 Hevolution/AFAR 新研究者奖主题类别 疫苗 和免疫治疗 (VAC) 的支持。

papers.abstract_zh: 摘要 简介 尽管 疫苗 可以预防近四十年,但 乙型肝炎病毒 (HBV) 感染仍然是全球主要的健康问题。尽管 疫苗接种 显着降低了疾病负担,但仍有一部分人未能形成足够的保护,并被归类为无反应者。方法 一项纵向研究评估了既往有或没有 疫苗接种 的个体的乙型肝炎 疫苗 反应。参与者接受了 3 剂明矾佐剂或 2 剂 CpG 佐剂 疫苗,其中一部分接受了加强剂。ELISA 分析了第 1、8 和 30 天收集的血液样本,以量化抗 HBs 滴度,分为高 (≥50 mIU/mL)、中 (10-50 mIU/mL) 或低 (≤10 mIU/mL)。使用改良的 ELISA 和离液剂来测量抗体亲合力,以评估结合强度。结果年龄显着影响 疫苗 反应。在加强组中,50 岁以下的参与者具有较高的基线滴度,而在从头组中,较年轻的个体表现出更强的早期反应,尽管不同年龄段的最终滴度相似。在高血压参与者中,老年人表现出较慢但稳定的抗体增加,在第 4 周超过年轻参与者。两个 疫苗 组的亲合力保持稳定,表明先前的 疫苗 增加了抗体数量,但没有增加结合强度,并在早期达到稳定水平。结论 先前接种过疫苗的个体的免疫记忆是可变的。尽管加强剂产生了更快的抗体上升,但无反应者比例较高,这表明之前的 疫苗接种 并不总是能确保持久的保护。高血压也影响了 疫苗 反应:虽然高血压个体实现了早期血清转换,但其抗体水平稳定在较低水平,表明免疫维持受损可能与血管炎症或内皮功能障碍有关。总体而言,这些发现强调了针对高血压或高龄个体的个性化 疫苗接种 策略的需要。资金来源 本摘要中报告的研究得到了美国国立卫生研究院国家过敏和传染病研究所的支持,奖项编号为 AI158617。此外,还得到 Hevolution/AFAR 新研究者奖主题类别 疫苗 和免疫疗法 (VAC) 的支持

papers.title: Divergent hepatitis B neutralizing antibody trajectories after spontaneous control in people with and without HIV
papers.abstract: Abstract People with HIV (PWH) have reduced spontaneous control (SC) of acute hepatitis B virus (HBV) infection and increased risk of HBV reactivation, but whether protective antibodies against hepatitis B surface antigen (anti-HBs) remain functional after SC is unclear. We analyzed longitudinal antibody responses of 136 men in the MACS/WIHS Combined Cohort Study with incident HBV followed by SC (99 people without HIV [PWoH], 37 PWH) at the first visit consistent with SC and approximately 6 and 30 months later. Anti HBs titers increased over 2.5 years after SC in PWoH but not PWH. Similarly, HBV neutralization was higher after SC in PWoH and remained stable, while trending downward in PWH. In contrast, antibodies against core antigen declined similarly in both groups. Unexpectedly, hepatitis B surface antigen–anti-HBs immune complexes (HBsAg ICs) were present in the majority of samples and remained stable over time. These findings support persistent HBsAg production after SC, which leads to increasing functional anti-HBs control in PWoH that is impaired by HIV potentially explaining effects of HIV on recovery and reactivation risk.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to investigate whether protective antibodies against hepatitis B surface antigen (anti-HBs) remain functional after spontaneous control (SC) of acute hepatitis B virus (HBV) infection in people with and without HIV.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study analyzed longitudinal antibody responses from 136 men in the MACS/WIHS Combined Cohort Study, including 99 people without HIV (PWoH) and 37 people with HIV (PWH) who experienced incident HBV followed by spontaneous control.
analysis.methods: Longitudinal antibody responses were assessed at the first visit consistent with spontaneous control and approximately 6 and 30 months later, focusing on anti-HBs titers, HBV neutralization, core antigen antibodies, and HBsAg-anti-HBs immune complexes.
analysis.main_results: Anti-HBs titers increased over 2.5 years after SC in PWoH but not in PWH. HBV neutralization was higher and stable in PWoH, while it trended downward in PWH. Antibodies against core antigen declined similarly in both groups. HBsAg-anti-HBs immune complexes were present in the majority of samples and remained stable over time.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The findings suggest that persistent HBsAg production after SC leads to increasing functional anti-HBs control in PWoH, which is impaired by HIV, potentially explaining effects of HIV on recovery and reactivation risk.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: These results may inform understanding of how HIV affects HBV recovery and reactivation risk, with implications for surveillance and management strategies in HIV-positive individuals with HBV.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited to a specific population and timeframe, and the evidence is based on abstract-only data, which may lack detailed statistical or methodological validation. The confidence in these findings is moderate.

analysis.summary_en: This study examines the trajectory of hepatitis B neutralizing antibodies after spontaneous control of acute HBV infection in people with and without HIV. It finds that anti-HBs titers increase over time in individuals without HIV but not in those with HIV. HBV neutralization is higher and stable in HIV-negative individuals, while it declines in HIV-positive individuals. Core antigen antibodies decline similarly in both groups, but HBsAg-anti-HBs immune complexes remain stable. These results suggest that HIV may impair the functional anti-HBs control that occurs after HBV spontaneous control, potentially influencing recovery and reactivation risk. The study is based on longitudinal data from the MACS/WIHS Combined Cohort Study, with a moderate confidence assessment due to its abstract-only nature.

elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究分析了 MACS/WIHS 联合 队列研究 研究中 136 名男性的纵向抗体反应,其中包括 99 名未感染 HIV 的人 (PWoH) 和 37 名经历过 HBV 感染并随后自发控制的 HIV 感染者 (PWH)。
elements_zh.methods: 在第一次就诊时评估纵向抗体反应,与自发对照一致,并在大约 6 个月和 30 个月后评估,重点关注抗 HBs 滴度、HBV 中和、核心抗原抗体和 HBsAg-抗 HBs 免疫复合物。

elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 研究结果表明,SC 后持续产生的 HBsAg 导致 PWoH 中功能性抗 HBs 控制的增加,而这种控制受到 HIV 的损害,这可能解释了 HIV 对恢复和再激活风险的影响。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些结果可能有助于了解 HIV 如何影响 HBV 恢复和再激活风险,并对 监测 和 HIV 阳性 HBV 患者的管理策略产生影响。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究仅限于特定人群和时间范围,证据仅基于抽象数据,可能缺乏详细的统计或方法学验证。这些发现的可信度是中等的。

papers.title: Impact of a multilevel hospital intervention on hepatitis screening and risk management in neuroinflammatory patients receiving immune therapy.
papers.abstract: BACKGROUND: Patients with neuroinflammatory disorders receiving immune therapy are at risk of hepatitis B virus (HBV) and hepatitis C virus (HCV) reactivation, particularly in endemic regions. However, adherence to recommended hepatitis screening prior to immune therapy remains inconsistent in neurological practice. This study evaluated whether a hospital-based intervention could improve hepatitis screening and risk management in this population. METHODS: We conducted a retrospective-prospective cohort study in the neurology departments of a tertiary medical center and a regional hospital in Taiwan. The intervention included clinician education, electronic medical record-based screening alerts, and periodic feedback on screening adherence. Screening uptake, screening timeliness, and clinical management actions were compared between pre-intervention (December 2018-May 2021) and post-intervention (June 2021-November 2023) cohorts. RESULTS: A total of 344 patients receiving immune therapy for neuroinflammatory disorders were included. Pre-immune therapy screening rates improved significantly after the intervention for HBsAg (37.1% to 63.3%), anti-HBc (10.1% to 31.8%), and anti-HCV (34.3% to 59.8%) (all p < 0.001). Overall screening rates, including in-therapy testing, also increased substantially. Time-to-screening analysis demonstrated shorter delays for in-therapy screening after the intervention. Clinical responses following HBV identification-including HBV DNA testing, hepatology referral, and antiviral prophylaxis-were significantly more frequent in the post-intervention period. Improved screening also revealed previously unrecognized HBV carriage and reactivation events. CONCLUSIONS: A structured hospital-based intervention integrating clinician education, electronic reminders, and feedback significantly improved hepatitis screening and downstream clinical management in neuroinflammatory patients receiving immune therapy. These findings support incorporating systematic hepatitis risk assessment into neurological care in HBV/HCV-endemic regions.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 接受免疫治疗的神经炎症性疾病患者面临着 乙型肝炎病毒 (HBV) 再激活的风险,特别是在流行地区,但在神经病学实践中,治疗前遵守推荐的 HBV 筛查的情况仍然不一致。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 一项回顾性-前瞻性队列研究研究在台湾一家三级医疗中心和一家地方医院的神经内科进行,比较了接受神经炎症性疾病免疫治疗的患者干预前(2018年12月至2021年5月)和干预后(2021年6月至2023年11月)的队列研究。

elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者将研究结果解读为,整合教育、电子提醒和反馈的结构化医院干预措施显着改善了这一高危人群的肝炎筛查和下游临床管理。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现支持将系统性肝炎风险评估纳入乙型肝炎病毒流行地区的神经护理中,以减轻免疫治疗期间的再激活风险。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究因其回顾性前瞻性设计、单一国家背景和缺乏随机性而受到限制,限制了因果推断和普遍性,需要对证据有适度的信心。

papers.title: Construction and validation of a predictive model for HBsAg loss in chronic hepatitis B patients treated with Peg-IFNα-2b
papers.abstract: Background Hepatitis B surface antigen (HBsAg) loss is the ideal treatment endpoint for chronic hepatitis B (CHB). Pegylated interferon alfa-2b (Peg-IFNα-2b) is currently the preferred drug for achieving HBsAg loss, but its efficacy varies significantly among different patients. Methods This multicenter, retrospective real-world study enrolled CHB patients treated with Peg-IFNα-2b for ≥48 weeks. Patients were divided into cured and uncured groups based on week-48 HBsAg status and randomly assigned to training and validation cohorts (7:3). Logistic regression identified independent predictors of HBsAg loss and constructed a predictive model. The model’s discriminative ability, calibration, and clinical applicability were evaluated using receiver operating characteristic (ROC) curve analysis, calibration curves, Hosmer–Lemeshow test, and decision analysis curve (DCA) analysis. Results Among 859 patients, 133 (15.5%) achieved HBsAg loss at week 48. Multivariate analysis identified combination therapy with traditional Chinese medicine (TCM) (OR = 3.83), lower baseline HBsAg (OR = 0.32), lower baseline aspartate aminotransferase (AST) (OR = 0.97), and entecavir (ETV) regimen (OR = 0.33) as independent predictors. The model demonstrated strong discrimination and calibration performance, with AUCs of 0.884 in the training cohort and 0.866 in the validation cohort. Logit(P)=-0.87-1.12*HBsAg(log10)+1.34*group-0.03*AST-1.1×ETV. Note: group (1=no combination with TCM, 2=combination with TCM), ETV (0=non-ETV antiviral regimen, 1=ETV antiviral regimen). Conclusion The combination of TCM therapy, low baseline HBsAg levels, lower baseline AST levels, and non-ETV antiviral regimens were significant predictors of HBsAg loss at week 48 in CHB patients receiving 48-week Peg-IFNα-2b treatment. The predictive model we developed demonstrated high accuracy and potential clinical utility. Key points This study focused on the establishment and validation of a clinical prediction model for HBsAg loss based on a large two-center cohort including 859 patients with CHB. The model was constructed using rigorous statistical methods and further evaluated through both internal and external validation. The results demonstrated good discrimination, calibration, and clinical net benefit, suggesting that the model may serve as a practical tool to help clinicians estimate the probability of HBsAg loss and facilitate individualized antiviral treatment strategies.

papers.source_body_en: Background Hepatitis B surface antigen (HBsAg) loss is the ideal treatment endpoint for chronic hepatitis B (CHB). papers.title: Precise immunomodulation by mesenchymal stem cells mitigates hepatitis B virus-specific CD8+ T cell-mediated acute liver injury without compromising viral clearance
papers.abstract: Hepatitis B virus-related acute-on-chronic liver failure (HBV-ACLF) is associated with a high mortality rate. Although mesenchymal stem cell (MSC) therapy markedly improves liver function and survival in patients with HBV-ACLF, it remains unclear whether the immunomodulatory effects of MSCs suppress antiviral CD8+ T cell function and trigger HBV reactivation. Here, we developed a novel in vitro HBV-specific CD8+ T cell–mediated acute liver injury organoid model, which was co-cultured with either menstrual blood-derived MSCs (MenSCs) or umbilical cord-derived MSCs (UC-MSCs). We found that both MenSCs and UC-MSCs coordinate liver repair and antiviral immunity through precise immunomodulation, primarily via paracrine signaling. Both MSC types significantly downregulated pro-inflammatory ( IFN-γ , TNF-α , IL-8 , and CXCL10 ) and apoptosis-related genes ( FasL and CASP7 ), while promoting hepatic regeneration through IL-6 and HGF upregulation, without compromising CD8+ T cell-mediated HBV clearance. This study provides critical insights into the safety of MSC therapy for HBV-ACLF.

papers.title: Molecular Basis and Clinical Significance of the High-risk Phenotype of Hepatitis B Virus Genotype C
papers.abstract: Hepatitis B virus (HBV) genotype C is common in East Asia and is associated with poor outcomes, particularly liver cirrhosis and hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC). Clinically, genotype C infection is generally associated with persistent viral replication, later HBeAg seroconversion, more active hepatic inflammation, and an increased risk of HCC. Current evidence suggests that these features are driven by several key molecular events, including the A1762T/G1764A double mutation in the basal core promoter, the G1896A mutation in the precore region, abnormal hepatitis B virus X protein function, and viral integration. Together, these changes may reshape viral transcription, antigen expression, host immune interactions, and oncogenic signaling, thereby contributing to disease progression and hepatocarcinogenesis. Other factors, such as epigenetic changes, dysregulated DNA damage responses, impaired tumor protein p53 function, and disrupted autophagy, may also be involved, although their exact roles remain unclear. Notably, even after effective viral suppression with potent nucleos(t)ide analogs, patients with genotype C may still have a relatively high residual risk of HCC. This review summarizes the molecular virological features, pathogenic mechanisms, immune dysregulation, and clinical significance of HBV genotype C, and discusses the potential value of genotype information in risk stratification, long-term surveillance, and clinical assessment of chronic hepatitis B.

papers.abstract_zh: 乙型肝炎病毒 (HBV) 基因型 C 在东亚很常见,与不良预后相关,特别是肝硬化和肝细胞癌 (HCC)。临床上,C 基因型感染通常与持续的病毒复制、较晚的 HBeAg 血清转换、更活跃的肝脏炎症以及 HCC 风险增加有关。目前的证据表明,这些特征是由几个关键分子事件驱动的,包括基础核心启动子中的 A1762T/G1764A 双 突变、前核心区域中的 G1896A 突变、异常的 乙型肝炎病毒 X 蛋白功能和病毒整合。这些变化共同可能重塑病毒转录、抗原表达、宿主 免疫相互作用和致癌信号传导,从而促进疾病进展和肝癌发生。其他因素,如表观遗传变化、DNA损伤反应失调、肿瘤蛋白p53功能受损和自噬破坏等也可能参与其中,尽管它们的确切作用仍不清楚。值得注意的是,即使在使用有效的核苷(酸)类似物有效抑制病毒后,C 基因型患者仍可能具有相对较高的 HCC 残留风险。本文综述了C型HBV的分子病毒学特征、致病机制、免疫失调和临床意义,并讨论了基因型信息在风险分层、长期监测和慢性乙型肝炎临床评估中的潜在价值。

papers.title: Prevalence, incidence and residual risk of HBV, HCV and HIV in Turkish Red Crescent blood donors: A 9‐year survey initiated with the implementation of nucleic acid testing (2015–2023)
papers.abstract: BACKGROUND AND OBJECTIVES: Nucleic acid testing (NAT) has improved blood safety by shortening the diagnostic window period (WP) for transfusion-transmissible infections. Within the context of a national NAT-based screening programme, this study evaluated temporal trends for hepatitis B virus (HBV), hepatitis C virus (HCV) and human immunodeficiency virus (HIV) among Turkish Red Crescent blood donors between 2015 and 2023. MATERIALS AND METHODS: A retrospective analysis was conducted on 22,494,116 blood donations screened by serology and NAT. Prevalence, incidence and residual risk (RR) were estimated using standard incidence/WP models. Temporal trends were evaluated using linear regression, and NAT yield was assessed cumulatively. RESULTS: The overall confirmed positivity (per 100,000 donors) was 288.5 for HBV, 16.2 for HCV and 14.8 for HIV. HBV and HCV showed significant downward trends (p < 0.01), while HIV rose significantly (p < 0.01). Cumulative NAT yields were 189.35, 2.94 and 2.15 per million donations for HBV, HCV and HIV, respectively. Between 2015 and 2023, the estimated overall RR per million donations declined for HBV (634.79 to 238.34) and HCV (1.69 to 0.99), but rose for HIV (4.08 to 11.40). Notably, the rising HIV RR-contrasting with the decline for HCV-was driven by increasing repeat-donor incidence and differences in the WP models used for risk estimation. CONCLUSION: While NAT-based screening was associated with low, declining RR for HBV and HCV, the rising HIV trajectory is concerning. This underscores the need for enhanced behavioural screening and donor selection strategies alongside molecular testing to address rising HIV risks.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 背景和目的:核酸检测(NAT)通过缩短输血传播感染的诊断窗口期(WP)来提高血液安全性。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 在基于 NAT 的国家筛查计划的背景下,本研究评估了 2015 年至 2023 年间土耳其红新月会献血者中 乙型肝炎病毒 (HBV)、丙型肝炎病毒 (HCV) 和人类免疫缺陷病毒 (HIV) 的时间趋势。
elements_zh.methods: 对血清学和NAT筛查的22,494,116份献血进行回顾性分析。使用标准 发病率/WP 模型估计 发病率、发病率 和残余风险 (RR)。使用线性回归评估时间趋势,并累积评估 NAT 产量。

elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 虽然基于 NAT 的筛查与 HBV 和 HCV 的 RR 较低且不断下降有关,但 HIV 的上升轨迹令人担忧。这强调需要加强行为筛查和捐助者选择策略以及分子检测,以应对不断上升的艾滋病毒风险。

papers.title: Antiviral activity of novel chemical compound 0411, derived from FUBP1-IN-1 against hepatitis B virus by upregulation of DUSP5
papers.abstract: Current first-line drugs rarely achieve functional curesfor chronic hepatitis B patients, which urges us to explore novel anti-HBV therapeutic strategies. In this study, we found that the novel chemical compound 0411, a derivative of the FUBP1 inhibitor, FUBPI-IN-1, significantly suppressed HBV transcription both in vitro and in vivo. Transcriptome sequencing demonstrated that 0411 treatment markedly upregulated the expression of the dual-specificity phosphatase 5 (DUSP5) gene, a crucial regulator of the MAPK pathway. Further functional studies illustrated that the antiviral activity of compound 0411 was dependent on DUSP5. Mechanismly, 0411 treatment in HepG2-NTCP cells enhances the deposition of active histone modifications on the promoter of DUSP5 significantly. In conclusion, our findings demonstrate the potential of 0411 as an effective agent against HBV transcription.

papers.source_body_en: Current first-line drugs rarely achieve functional curesfor chronic hepatitis B patients, which urges us to explore novel anti-HBV therapeutic strategies. In this study, we found that the novel chemical compound 0411, a derivative of the FUBP1 inhibitor, FUBPI-IN-1, significantly suppressed HBV transcription both in vitro and in vivo. Transcriptome sequencing demonstrated that 0411 treatment markedly upregulated the expression of the dual-specificity phosphatase 5 (DUSP5) gene, a crucial regulator of the MAPK pathway. Further functional studies illustrated that the antiviral activity of compound 0411 was dependent on DUSP5. Mechanismly, 0411 treatment in HepG2-NTCP cells enhances the deposition of active histone modifications on the promoter of DUSP5 significantly. In conclusion, our findings demonstrate the potential of 0411 as an effective agent against HBV transcription.
papers.abstract_zh: 目前的一线药物很少能对慢性乙型肝炎患者实现功能性治愈,这促使我们探索新的抗HBV治疗策略。在这项研究中,我们发现新型化合物 0411(FUBP1 抑制剂 FUBPI-IN-1 的衍生物)在体外和体内均显着抑制 HBV 转录。转录组测序表明,0411 治疗 显着上调双特异性磷酸酶 5 (DUSP5) 基因的表达,该基因是 MAPK 途径的关键调节因子。进一步的功能研究表明,化合物0411的抗病毒药物活性依赖于DUSP5。从机制上讲,HepG2-NTCP 细胞中的 0411 治疗 显着增强了活性组蛋白修饰在 DUSP5 启动子上的沉积。总之,我们的研究结果证明了 0411 作为有效抗 HBV 转录药物的潜力。

papers.title: Resolved HBV infection is an independent risk factor for enhanced systemic inflammatory responses in COVID-19 patients
papers.abstract: Purpose To investigate the systemic inflammatory responses and outcomes in coronavirus disease 2019 (COVID-19) patients with resolved hepatitis B virus (HBV) infection or non-HBV infection. Methods This single-center, retrospective study was conducted in Tongji Hospital of Wuhan, China, from 20 January 2020 to 30 March 2020. A total of 215 COVID-19 cases with available test results were included. Demographic and clinical characteristics, and results of laboratory test results, were collected and analyzed. Results Of the 215 included patients, the numbers of patients with current HBV infection, resolved HBV infection, and non-HBV infection were 15, 134, and 66, respectively. Inflammatory biomarkers, such as C-reactive protein (CRP), procalcitonin (PCT), and ferritin, were significantly elevated in the resolved HBV infection group, as well pro-inflammatory cytokines, including interleukin-6 (IL-6), soluble interleukin-2 receptor (sIL-2R), tumor necrosis factor alpha (TNF- α ), and IL-8. Resolved HBV infection was independently associated with elevated proinflammatory cytokines. Patients with resolved HBV infection (59.7%) were more likely to develop into a severe state compared to patients with current HBV infection (46.7%) and non-HBV infection (43.9%). Conclusion Resolved HBV infection is an independent risk factor for patients with COVID-19. COVID-19 patients with resolved HBV infection are more likely to have enhanced systemic inflammatory responses and worse prognoses than those with non-HBV infection.

elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 这项单中心回顾性研究于2020年1月20日至2020年3月30日在中国武汉同济医院进行,涉及215例有可用检测结果的COVID-19病例。
elements_zh.methods: 收集和分析人口统计学和临床​​特征以及包括炎症生物标志物和促炎细胞因子在内的实验室测试结果,以比较不同 HBV 感染组的结果。

elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者将已解决的 HBV 感染解释为 COVID-19 患者全身炎症反应增强和预后较差的独立危险因素,强调了已解决的病毒感染与 COVID-19 严重程度之间的新关联。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现为 监测 和已解决 HBV 感染的 COVID-19 患者的风险评估提供了信息,可能指导有针对性的监测和干预措施,以减轻严重后果。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究的回顾性设计和单中心设置限制了普遍性,尽管由于报告的明确关联和统计显着性,证据强度中等。

papers.title: A novel LNP/mRNA-based STING immunotherapy approach for chronic HBV infection 2334947
papers.abstract: Abstract Introduction Chronic hepatitis B virus (HBV) infection remains a major global health burden. Current antiviral therapies suppress viral replication but fail to eliminate cccDNA or substantially reduce HBsAg, making functional cure rare. Innate immune control of HBV is limited by poor engagement of the STING pathway in hepatocytes due to low endogenous expression and inefficient agonist delivery. We developed a universal STING mimic (uniSTING) delivered via lipid nanoparticles encoding uniSTING mRNA, which drives formation of endomembrane-independent STING polymers and preferential activation of the IRF3/type I interferon axis while minimizing NF-κB signaling. Methods HBV-positive cells were treated with LNP/uniSTING, followed by assessment of type I interferon and interferon-stimulated genes (ISG) induction. In vivo, HBV carrier mice were administered LNP/uniSTING, and serum HBV viremia were monitored alongside HBV-specific innate and adaptive immune responses. Results uniSTING elicited strong IFN-I responses in HBV negative cells. In the HepAD38 cell line where HBV transcription from the integrated HBV genome is suppressed by doxycycline to produce HBV predominantly from HBV cccDNA, uniSTING induced robust IFN-β and ISGs expression, whereas in the Dox- condition, characterized by high-level HBV replication, uniSTING-induced IFN-β and ISG responses were attenuated. In vivo, administration of LNP/uniSTING to naive mice induced robust IFN-β production and ISG expression. In chronic HBV carrier mice, repeated administration of LNP/uniSTING resulted in sustained reductions in serum HBV DNA and HBsAg levels, accompanied by induction of anti-HBs IgG responses. Conclusion These findings demonstrate that uniSTING can break HBV immune tolerance and elicit a functional anti-HBs antibody response in vivo. Collectively, this work highlights uniSTING as a promising immunotherapeutic strategy for chronic HBV infection by simultaneously activating innate antiviral pathways and promoting protective humoral immunity. Funding Source NIH R01 AI181664 Topic Categories Viral Immunology (VIR)

papers.title: Effect of skin tap technique on pain during hepatitis B vaccination among newborns: a randomized controlled trial
papers.abstract: Background: Pain is all about an unpleasant sensation created by stimuli. Every child has his or her own perception of pain. It is unpleasant sensory and emotional experience associated with actual or potential tissue damage. Mechanical stimulation given by taping can diminish the influence of tiny, pain-carrying fibers. This study aimed to assess the effect of skin tap technique on pain during hepatitis-B vaccination. Methods: A randomized controlled trial was carried out among 60 newborns in postnatal ward. Consecutive sampling technique was used to enroll the newborn who met the inclusion criteria. Data pertaining to newborn and a clinical characteristics birth order, gestation age, birth weight and mode of delivery were collected from medical record. Data regarding assess the level of pain during hepatitis-B vaccination by using the neonatal pain scale were collected from skin tap technique. Data were analyzed using Chi-square test, t-test. Results: The data collected was analyzed by using mean and standard deviation. The study findings high light that among 30 newborns vaccinated with the skin tap technique in the experimental group, the majority of newborns, 20 (66.7%), had mild to moderate pain, and 10 (33.3%) had severe pain. Among 30 newborns vaccinated as a routine manner in the control group, the majority of newborns, 22 (73.3%), had severe pain, and 8 (26.7%) had mild to moderate pain, respectively. The skin tap technique was effective compared to the control group. The pain score was 3.83±1.147 and 5±1.174. Respectively with a statistically significant p=0.000. Conclusions: The skin tap technique was effective in reducing pain during hepatitis-B vaccination among the newborns.

papers.abstract_zh: 背景:疼痛是由刺激产生的不愉快的感觉。每个孩子对疼痛都有自己的看法。它是与实际或潜在的组织损伤相关的不愉快的感觉和情感体验。胶带带来的机械刺激可以减少微小的、带有疼痛的纤维的影响。本研究旨在评估皮肤敲击技术对乙型肝炎 疫苗接种 期间疼痛的影响。方法:对产后病房60例新生儿进行随机对照试验。采用连续抽样技术纳入符合纳入标准的新生儿。从医疗记录中收集有关新生儿和临床特征、出生顺序、孕龄、出生体重和分娩方式的数据。通过皮肤敲击技术收集有关使用新生儿疼痛量表评估乙型肝炎 疫苗接种 期间疼痛水平的数据。使用卡方检验、t 检验分析数据。结果:使用平均值和标准差对收集的数据进行分析。研究结果强调,在实验组30名通过皮肤敲击技术接种疫苗的新生儿中,大多数新生儿(20名(66.7%))出现轻度至中度疼痛,10名(33.3%)出现重度疼痛。对照组30名常规接种的新生儿中,大多数新生儿出现剧烈疼痛,分别为22名(73.3%)和8名(26.7%)轻至中度疼痛。与对照组相比,皮肤敲击技术是有效的。疼痛评分为3.83±1.147和5±1.174。分别具有统计显着性p=0.000。结论:皮肤敲击技术可有效减轻新生儿乙型肝炎 疫苗接种 期间的疼痛。

papers.title: Value-based price corridor for bepirovirsen in chronic hepatitis B: an early health technology assessment in a cost-compressed setting
papers.abstract: We conducted an early health technology assessment (eHTA) of bepirovirsen, an investigational finite-course therapy for chronic hepatitis B. In China, low-cost generic nucleos(t)ide analogues (NAs) create a demanding comparator environment. The value-based price of a potential functional-cure strategy therefore depends on local comparator prices, threshold selection, cure durability, safety, monitoring requirements, and cured-state utility assumptions. A lifetime Markov model simulated bepirovirsen 300 mg/week for 24 weeks plus background NAs against comparator-specific standard-of-care options. Chinese cost inputs were valued in 2024 renminbi (RMB) and converted to US dollars using the 2024 annual average exchange rate of 7.1957 RMB per US dollar. The base case used a China-context cost-effectiveness threshold (CET) of $13,500 per quality-adjusted life-year (QALY), approximating China’s 2024 gross domestic product (GDP) per capita after currency conversion, and compared it with higher threshold scenarios. Because reliable long-term relapse rates were unavailable, a 48-week maintained-response scenario set bepirovirsen efficacy to 9.0%, corresponding to the B-Clear primary-outcome rate among participants receiving background NA therapy. Bepirovirsen yielded 0.41–0.82 incremental QALYs across standard-of-care comparators. Compared with entecavir (ETV), the base case generated 0.82 additional QALYs, incurred an incremental total cost of $10,833.72 per patient at the value-based price, and avoided 906 hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) cases per 10,000 patients. Under the $13,500/QALY threshold, the value-based price per dose ranged from $92.92 to $367.44 across comparators. In the 48-week maintained-response scenario, the value-based price per dose was $70.29 versus ETV and ranged from $28.62 to $294.24 across comparators. The societal-perspective scenario increased the value-based price per dose to $426.41. Model-cohort expected value of perfect information (EVPI) was $0.46 million at the base-case threshold. Bepirovirsen’s value-based price is conditional on comparator prices, CET selection, durability of hepatitis B surface antigen (HBsAg) seroclearance, safety, monitoring needs, and cured-state utility assumptions. These eHTA results are hypothesis-generating and should be interpreted within the limits of phase II-derived efficacy inputs, uncertain relapse pathways, and adverse-event and monitoring costs that cannot yet be estimated reliably. This early health technology assessment (eHTA) estimates a value-based price corridor for bepirovirsen, a finite-course investigational therapy for chronic hepatitis B, in a setting where low-cost generic nucleos(t)ide analogues (NAs) create a stringent comparator. At a $13,500 per quality-adjusted life-year (QALY) threshold, the model estimated a value-based price of $92.92-$367.44 per dose across standard-of-care comparators. Compared with entecavir (ETV), the base case produced 0.82 additional QALYs and an incremental total cost of $10,833.72 per patient at the value-based price. In the 48-week maintained-response scenario, the corresponding value-based price versus ETV was $70.29 per dose. Scenario analyses show that the corridor remains sensitive to maintained response, cured-state utility, societal-cost assumptions, and the selected cost-effectiveness threshold.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在估计贝匹罗韦森(慢性乙型肝炎 的一种研究性有限疗程疗法)的基于价值的价格走廊,在低成本通用核苷(酸)类似物创建严格的比较环境的情况下。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 使用终生马尔可夫模型进行了早期卫生技术评估 (eHTA),该模型模拟贝匹罗韦生 300 毫克/周,持续 24 周,加上背景核苷类似物,与中国特定的比较标准护理方案进行比较。

elements_zh.main_results: 与恩替卡韦相比,基本案例产生了 0.82 个额外的 QAL,按照基于价值的价格,每个患者的增量总成本为 10,833.72 美元,避免了每 10,000 名患者中 906 例肝细胞癌病例。

elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 由于依赖于 II 期疗效输入、不确定的长期复发率以及无法可靠地估计不良事件和监测成本,证据强度中等。

papers.title: Development and validation of a machine learning-derived dual-indicator tool for identification of hepatitis B virus-related pre-acute-on-chronic liver failure
papers.abstract: Background & aims Patients who do not meet the criteria for Acute-on-Chronic Liver Failure (ACLF) at admission still face a high risk of disease progression and mortality. This study aimed to develop and validate a machine learning-derived clinical tool for the early identification of HBV-pre-ACLF. Methods We analyzed 1,682 patients experiencing acute deterioration of HBV-related chronic liver disease but without ACLF. By random forest and SHAP analysis, we identified key predictors of ACLF onset within a 7-day window. We then validated the diagnostic thresholds in a test cohort of 260 patients. Results Total bilirubin (TBIL) and INR were identified as the most critical predictors of ACLF progression. We established optimal diagnostic thresholds at TBIL ≥131.5 μmol/L and INR ≥1.35. Two sequential criteria were developed: pre-ACLF-O (meeting either threshold) for highly sensitive screening, and pre-ACLF-A (meeting both thresholds) for risk confirmation. In the derivation cohort, pre-ACLF-O achieved 98.3% sensitivity, while pre-ACLF-A predicted a 33.09% positive predictive value. These results were successfully validated in the test cohort, where pre-ACLF-O maintained 100% sensitivity and pre-ACLF-A demonstrated a 37.04% positive predictive value. Conclusions This dual-indicator tool easily and effectively identifies HBV-pre-ACLF. Using these criteria sequentially provides a practical strategy for early risk stratification, allowing clinicians to initiate timely interventions for high-risk patients.

papers.source_body_en: Background & aims Patients who do not meet the criteria for Acute-on-Chronic Liver Failure (ACLF) at admission still face a high risk of disease progression and mortality. This study aimed to develop and validate a machine learning-derived clinical tool for the early identification of HBV-pre-ACLF. Methods We analyzed 1,682 patients experiencing acute deterioration of HBV-related chronic liver disease but without ACLF. By random forest and SHAP analysis, we identified key predictors of ACLF onset within a 7-day window. We then validated the diagnostic thresholds in a test cohort of 260 patients. Results Total bilirubin (TBIL) and INR were identified as the most critical predictors of ACLF progression. We established optimal diagnostic thresholds at TBIL ≥131.5 μmol/L and INR ≥1.35. Two sequential criteria were developed: pre-ACLF-O (meeting either threshold) for highly sensitive screening, and pre-ACLF-A (meeting both thresholds) for risk confirmation. In the derivation cohort, pre-ACLF-O achieved 98.3% sensitivity, while pre-ACLF-A predicted a 33.09% positive predictive value. These results were successfully validated in the test cohort, where pre-ACLF-O maintained 100% sensitivity and pre-ACLF-A demonstrated a 37.04% positive predictive value. Conclusions This dual-indicator tool easily and effectively identifies HBV-pre-ACLF. Using these criteria sequentially provides a practical strategy for early risk stratification, allowing clinicians to initiate timely interventions for high-risk patients.

papers.title: Novel HBx-interacting host cellular factors regulate dynamic nuclear and cytoplasmic localization of Hepatitis B virus X protein (HBx)
papers.abstract: The hepatitis B virus (HBV) X protein (HBx) is a key player in viral transcription, replication, and HBV-associated hepatocarcinogenesis. Several novel HBx-interacting host cellular factors: DDX1, DDX3, MOV10 RNA helicases, INI1/hSNF5 chromatin-remodeling factor, Rad18 DNA repair enzyme, and CPSF6 cleavage factor were identified. DDX1, DDX3, and MOV10 colocalized with HBx in cytoplasmic foci or aggregates. In contrast, INI1/hSNF5 and CPSF6 relocalized with HBx in nuclear speckles, interchromatin granule clusters (IGCs), and/or PML-nuclear bodies. Rad18 sequestered HBx in the nucleoli. Importantly, DDX3, MOV10, and INI1/hSNF5 restricted HBV replication, whereas CPSF6 facilitated HBV replication. Furthermore, DDX1 enhanced HBx-mediated NF-κB transcription, whereas MOV10 and Rad18 inhibited it. Altogether, HBx-interacting host factors determine dynamic nuclear and cytoplasmic localization of HBx and regulate HBV replication and HBx-mediated transcription.

papers.title_zh: 新型 HBx 相互作用的 宿主 细胞因子调节 乙型肝炎病毒 X 蛋白 (HBx) 的动态核和细胞质定位
papers.source_body_en: The hepatitis B virus (HBV) X protein (HBx) is a key player in viral transcription, replication, and HBV-associated hepatocarcinogenesis. Several novel HBx-interacting host cellular factors: DDX1, DDX3, MOV10 RNA helicases, INI1/hSNF5 chromatin-remodeling factor, Rad18 DNA repair enzyme, and CPSF6 cleavage factor were identified. DDX1, DDX3, and MOV10 colocalized with HBx in cytoplasmic foci or aggregates. In contrast, INI1/hSNF5 and CPSF6 relocalized with HBx in nuclear speckles, interchromatin granule clusters (IGCs), and/or PML-nuclear bodies. Rad18 sequestered HBx in the nucleoli. Importantly, DDX3, MOV10, and INI1/hSNF5 restricted HBV replication, whereas CPSF6 facilitated HBV replication. Furthermore, DDX1 enhanced HBx-mediated NF-κB transcription, whereas MOV10 and Rad18 inhibited it. Altogether, HBx-interacting host factors determine dynamic nuclear and cytoplasmic localization of HBx and regulate HBV replication and HBx-mediated transcription.

papers.title: Hubungan Kadar Albumin Plasma pada Penderita TB Mdr dengan Ko-Infeksi Hepatitis B
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Tuberculosis is a chronic infectious disease caused by the bacterium Mycobacterium tuberculosis. Resistance of the Mycobacterium tuberculosis (Mtb) germ is caused by spontaneous mutations in the chromosome. The proportion of Mtb germs that have undergone mutation (wild-type resistant mutants) in patients who have never received OAT is very small. TB treatment causes selective inhibition of the Mtb germ population, leading to the killing of sensitive Mtb germs, while the mutant population will reproduce and cause resistance to OAT (acquired resistance). A common co-infection in TB patients is Hepatitis B. Hepatitis B infection is a liver disease that causes inflammation and damage to hepatocytes. Chronic hepatitis B virus (HBV) infection in tuberculosis patients ranges from 0.5% to 44%. Hypoalbuminemia is often associated with both TB and Hepatitis B. It frequently occurs in hepatitis B due to liver damage caused by hepatitis B virus infection, while in TB, hypoalbuminemia is often linked to malnutrition and poor nutritional intake in TB patients. This hypothesis aligns with the patient's current condition, where the patient is diagnosed with hepatitis B confirmed by laboratory results showing HBsAg values 1000. Additionally, the patient also suffers from MDR TB with poor nutritional intake, as evidenced by the patient's BMI of only 19.53. Keywords: Hepatitis B, Hypoalbuminemia, Co-infection, Multi-drug resistant, Tuberculosis, Multi-Drug Resistant. ABSTRAK Tuberkulosis ada suatu penyakit kronik menular yang disebabkan oleh bakteri Mycobacterium tuberculosis. Resistansi kuman Mycobacterium tuberculosis (Mtb) disebabkan oleh mutasi spontan pada kromosom. Proporsi kuman Mtb yang sudah mengalami mutasi (wild-type resistant mutants) pada pasien yang tidak pernah mendapatkan OAT sangat sedikit. Pengobatan TB menyebabkan hambatan selektif pada populasi kuman Mtb sehingga kuman Mtb sensitif dibunuh, sementara populasi mutan akan bereproduksi dan menyebabkan terjadinya resistansi terhadap OAT (resistansi didapat). Ko-infeksi yang sering terjadi pada pasien TB adalah Hepatitis B. Infeksi hepatitis B adalah penyakit hati yang menyebabkan peradangan dan kerusakan hepatosit. Infeksi virus hepatitis B (HBV) kronis pada pasien tuberkulosis berkisar antara 0,5% hingga 44%. Hipoalbuminemia sering dikaitkan dengan penyakit TB maupun Hepatitis B. Pada hepatitis B sering terjadi dikarenakan adanya kerusakan hati yang disebabkan oleh infeksi virus hepatitis B, sedangkan pada TB sering terjadi hipoalbumin dikaitkan dengan malnutrisi dan kurangnya asupan gizi pada pasien TB. Hipotesis ini sesuai dengan kondisi pasien pada saat ini, dimana pasien didiagnosis hepatitis B yang ditegakkan dengan hasil pemeriksaan labortarorium dimana nilai HBsAg 1000, selain itu pasien juga menderita TB MDR dengan asupan gizi yang buruk, dimana dapat dilihat BMI pasien hanya 19.53. Kata Kunci: Hepatitis B, Hipoalbuminemia, Ko-Infeksi, Multi Drug Resistant, Tuberkulosis, Multi Drug Resistant.

analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The study highlights the importance of monitoring albumin levels in MDR TB patients with hepatitis B co-infection to assess nutritional status and liver function.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 该研究旨在探讨耐多药结核病(MDR TB)患者血浆白蛋白水平与合并感染乙型肝炎之间的关系。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究检查了一名被诊断为乙型肝炎的患者,实验室结果显示 HBsAg 值为 1000,且患有耐多药结核病,且营养摄入不足,BMI 仅 19.53。
elements_zh.methods: 该研究假设低白蛋白血症与结核病和乙型肝炎有关,乙型肝炎会导致肝损伤,而结核病则与营养不良和营养摄入不足有关。
elements_zh.main_results: 患者的病情与假设相符,实验室结果证实患有乙型肝炎,并且患有耐多药结核病且营养摄入不足,BMI 为 19.53。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 研究结果表明,合并感染患者的低白蛋白血症可能是由乙型肝炎引起的肝损伤和结核病相关营养不良造成的。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 该研究强调了监测合并乙型肝炎的耐多药结核病患者的白蛋白水平对于评估营养状况和肝功能的重要性。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该证据基于单个病例研究,限制了普遍性,但提供了对低白蛋白血症、结核病和乙型肝炎合并感染之间关系的具体见解。

papers.title: Development of T-cell-based immunotherapy against chronic Hepatitis B infection 2309924
papers.abstract: Abstract Introduction Even though T cells are known to be essential for Hepatitis B virus (HBV) clearance, there is currently no FDA-approved immunotherapy against chronic HBV infection, one of the major global causes of liver cancer, hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC). We aimed to characterize and test HBV-specific T cell receptors (TCRs) in a rhesus macaque (RMs) model of acute HBV clearance. Methods We analyzed HBV-specific T cell responses using non-parenchymal liver cells from RMs that cleared HBV by enzyme-linked immunospot and intracellular cytokine staining (ICS). We live-sorted activated HBV-specific CD8+ T cells from an animal with the strongest response using the TNF-α processing inhibitor (TAPI-0) and analyzed their transcriptional profile as well as T cell receptors (TCRs) via single-cell RNAseq. We used the retroviral method of expressing the α and β TCR chains from the top 8 most enriched TCRs in naive CD8+ T cells to confirm their specificity, map the minimal epitope, and identify MHC restriction. Results We identified three animals with strong CD8+ T cell responses against the same HBV surface 15-mer. The transcriptional profile showed that the responding CD8+ T cells primarily expressed αβ TCR chains and were highly activated. Using ICS, we confirmed the anti-viral activity of 3 TCRs. Peptide dilution experiments using T cells transduced with these TCRs showed that the immunogenic peptide is FLLTRILTI, which is known to be presented by HLA-A*02 in humans. We also determined that in RMs the restricting allele for this peptide is Mamu-B*031:01:01. Conclusion One of the main challenges in developing immunotherapy against chronic HBV infection is a lack of pre-clinical animal models. We show that RMs can be used to identify HBV-specific CD8+ T cell responses. Future directions include developing MHC-peptide tetramers to detect and elucidate HBV-specific T cell responses, identifying HBV-specific TCRs against other HBV proteins, and testing T-cell-based immunotherapy efficiency and safety. Funding Source n/a Topic Categories Vaccines and Immunotherapy (VAC)

analysis.research_question_and_background: Chronic hepatitis B virus (HBV) infection remains a major global cause of hepatocellular carcinoma with no FDA-approved immunotherapy despite the essential role of T cells in viral clearance. The study addressed the lack of pre-clinical animal models for developing HBV-specific immunotherapies.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study characterized and tested HBV-specific T cell receptors (TCRs) in a rhesus macaque (RMs) model of acute HBV clearance. Non-parenchymal liver cells from RMs that cleared HBV were analyzed to identify HBV-specific CD8+ T cell responses.
analysis.methods: HBV-specific T cell responses were analyzed using enzyme-linked immunospot and intracellular cytokine staining (ICS) on non-parenchymal liver cells. Activated HBV-specific CD8+ T cells were live-sorted and their transcriptional profiles and TCRs were analyzed via single-cell RNA sequencing. The top 8 enriched TCRs were expressed in naive CD8+ T cells to confirm specificity, map the minimal epitope, and identify MHC restriction.
analysis.main_results: Three animals exhibited strong CD8+ T cell responses against the same HBV surface 15-mer. The responding CD8+ T cells primarily expressed αβ TCR chains and were highly activated. Three TCRs confirmed anti-viral activity via ICS, and peptide dilution experiments identified the immunogenic peptide as FLLTRILTI, presented by HLA-A*02 in humans and Mamu-B*031:01:01 in RMs.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The study demonstrates that rhesus macaques can serve as a pre-clinical model for identifying HBV-specific CD8+ T cell responses, addressing a key challenge in immunotherapy development. Novelty lies in characterizing immunogenic peptides and MHC restriction in this model.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings support the use of rhesus macaques as a model for evaluating HBV-specific T cell-based immunotherapies, potentially accelerating translational research for chronic HBV treatment.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited to an abstract-only evidence base, lacks detailed statistical analyses, and does not report clinical outcomes or safety data. The evidence strength is assessed as moderate due to the preliminary nature of the findings.

analysis.summary_en: This study aimed to address the lack of FDA-approved immunotherapies for chronic hepatitis B virus (HBV) infection by characterizing HBV-specific T cell receptors (TCRs) in a rhesus macaque model of acute HBV clearance. Using enzyme-linked immunospot, intracellular cytokine staining, and single-cell RNA sequencing, the authors identified strong CD8+ T cell responses against an HBV surface 15-mer in three animals. The responding T cells were highly activated and expressed αβ TCR chains. Three TCRs demonstrated anti-viral activity, and peptide mapping revealed the immunogenic peptide FLLTRILTI, which is presented by HLA-A*02 in humans and Mamu-B*031:01:01 in rhesus macaques. The study highlights the utility of rhesus macaques as a pre-clinical model for HBV immunotherapy development, though the evidence is preliminary and based solely on abstract data.

papers.source_body_en: Abstract Introduction Even though T cells are known to be essential for Hepatitis B virus (HBV) clearance, there is currently no FDA-approved immunotherapy against chronic HBV infection, one of the major global causes of liver cancer, hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC). We aimed to characterize and test HBV-specific T cell receptors (TCRs) in a rhesus macaque (RMs) model of acute HBV clearance. Methods We analyzed HBV-specific T cell responses using non-parenchymal liver cells from RMs that cleared HBV by enzyme-linked immunospot and intracellular cytokine staining (ICS). We live-sorted activated HBV-specific CD8+ T cells from an animal with the strongest response using the TNF-α processing inhibitor (TAPI-0) and analyzed their transcriptional profile as well as T cell receptors (TCRs) via single-cell RNAseq. We used the retroviral method of expressing the α and β TCR chains from the top 8 most enriched TCRs in naive CD8+ T cells to confirm their specificity, map the minimal epitope, and identify MHC restriction. Results We identified three animals with strong CD8+ T cell responses against the same HBV surface 15-mer. The transcriptional profile showed that the responding CD8+ T cells primarily expressed αβ TCR chains and were highly activated. Using ICS, we confirmed the anti-viral activity of 3 TCRs. Peptide dilution experiments using T cells transduced with these TCRs showed that the immunogenic peptide is FLLTRILTI, which is known to be presented by HLA-A*02 in humans. We also determined that in RMs the restricting allele for this peptide is Mamu-B*031:01:01. Conclusion One of the main challenges in developing immunotherapy against chronic HBV infection is a lack of pre-clinical animal models. We show that RMs can be used to identify HBV-specific CD8+ T cell responses. Future directions include developing MHC-peptide tetramers to detect and elucidate HBV-specific T cell responses, identifying HBV-specific TCRs against other HBV proteins, and testing T-cell-based immunotherapy efficiency and safety. Funding Source n/a Topic Categories Vaccines and Immunotherapy (VAC)

papers.title: ddOTs: A multiplexed quantitative ddPCR approach for resolving overlapping hepatitis B virus transcripts to decipher cccDNA-driven transcription
papers.abstract: Chronic hepatitis B virus infection persists as a global health crisis, driving life-threatening liver pathologies such as hepatocellular carcinoma. Central to HBV’s resilience is the covalently closed circular DNA (cccDNA), a viral minichromosome that orchestrates viral transcription and sustains infection. Dissecting cccDNA-driven transcription remains a formidable challenge due to the dense overlap of viral open reading frames, which generates RNA transcripts with shared sequences, complicating precise quantification and hindering efforts to unravel HBV’s transcriptional regulation. To address this bottleneck, we developed a multiplexed assay named ddPCR for Overlapping Transcripts (ddOTs) capable of simultaneously quantifying all major HBV RNA species, including splice variants, with unprecedented specificity and sensitivity. This method overcomes current limitations by leveraging the high-resolution power of ddPCR to deconvolute overlapping transcripts, enabling direct interrogation of individual promoter/enhancer activities and RNA stability. By offering a cost-effective, scalable solution for precise RNA profiling in rare biological samples, this breakthrough tool unlocks new avenues for exploring cccDNA biology and accelerating antiviral drug development.

papers.title_zh: ddOTs:一种多重定量 ddPCR 方法,用于解析重叠的 乙型肝炎病毒 转录本以破译 共价闭合环状DNA 驱动的转录
papers.source_body_en: Chronic hepatitis B virus infection persists as a global health crisis, driving life-threatening liver pathologies such as hepatocellular carcinoma. Central to HBV’s resilience is the covalently closed circular DNA (cccDNA), a viral minichromosome that orchestrates viral transcription and sustains infection. Dissecting cccDNA-driven transcription remains a formidable challenge due to the dense overlap of viral open reading frames, which generates RNA transcripts with shared sequences, complicating precise quantification and hindering efforts to unravel HBV’s transcriptional regulation. To address this bottleneck, we developed a multiplexed assay named ddPCR for Overlapping Transcripts (ddOTs) capable of simultaneously quantifying all major HBV RNA species, including splice variants, with unprecedented specificity and sensitivity. This method overcomes current limitations by leveraging the high-resolution power of ddPCR to deconvolute overlapping transcripts, enabling direct interrogation of individual promoter/enhancer activities and RNA stability. By offering a cost-effective, scalable solution for precise RNA profiling in rare biological samples, this breakthrough tool unlocks new avenues for exploring cccDNA biology and accelerating antiviral drug development.
papers.abstract_zh: 慢性乙型肝炎 病毒感染持续成为全球健康危机,导致肝细胞癌等危及生命的肝脏病变。HBV 恢复能力的核心是共价闭合环状 DNA (共价闭合环状DNA),这是一种病毒微型染色体,可以协调病毒转录并维持感染。由于病毒开放阅读框的密集重叠,剖析 共价闭合环状DNA 驱动的转录仍然是一项艰巨的挑战,这会产生具有共享序列的 RNA 转录本,使精确定量变得复杂,并阻碍了阐明 HBV 转录调控的努力。为了解决这个瓶颈,我们开发了一种名为 ddPCR for Overlapping Transcripts (ddOTs) 的多重检测,能够同时定量所有主要 HBV RNA 种类,包括剪接变体,具有前所未有的特异性和灵敏度。该方法通过利用 ddPCR 的高分辨率能力来解卷积重叠转录本,从而克服了当前的局限性,从而能够直接询问单个启动子/增强子活性和 RNA 稳定性。通过为稀有生物样品中的精确 RNA 分析提供经济高效、可扩展的解决方案,这一突破性工具为探索 共价闭合环状DNA 生物学和加速 抗病毒药物 药物开发开辟了新途径。

papers.title: lncRNA ZNF667-AS1 suppresses hepatitis B virus-related hepatocellular carcinoma by regulating miR-210-3p to upregulate CPEB2
papers.abstract: To explore the biological functions, clinical significance, and regulatory mechanism of long non-coding RNA (lncRNA) ZNF667-AS1 in hepatitis B virus (HBV)-related hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC). One hundred and seven patients with HBV-related HCC, one hundred and five patients with chronic hepatitis B (CHB) and one hundred and five healthy controls were enrolled in this study. Real-time quantitative polymerase chain reaction (RT-qPCR) was used to detect the expression levels of ZNF667-AS1, miR-210-3p, CPEB2. The association between ZNF667-AS1 expression and clinical characteristics of patients were analyzed, and receiver operating characteristic (ROC) curve analysis was performed to evaluate its diagnostic value. Bioinformatics prediction and dual-luciferase reporter assays were conducted to verify the targeted associations between ZNF667-AS1 and miR-210-3p, as well as between miR-210-3p and CPEB2. Cell Counting Kit-8 (CCK-8) and Transwell assays were applied to assess the biological functions of HCC cells after cell transfection. The expression levels of ZNF667-AS1 and CPEB2 were significantly downregulated in tissue samples from patients with HBV-related HCC and in HBV-associated HCC cell lines. ROC curve analysis showed the area under the curve (AUC) of ZNF667-AS1 for diagnosing HBV-related HCC from CHB reached 0.841. miR-210-3p was validated as a direct target of ZNF667-AS1, and a significant negative correlation was observed between their expression levels. Overexpression of ZNF667-AS1 inhibited the proliferation, migration, and invasion of HCC cells, whereas this inhibitory effect was reversed by transfection with miR-210-3p mimic. LncRNA ZNF667-AS1 is downregulated in HBV-related HCC and exerts in vitro tumor‐suppressive effects by targeting miR-210-3p to upregulate CPEB2 expression, thus providing a potential auxiliary biomarker for HBV-related HCC diagnosis and a novel regulatory axis for understanding disease pathogenesis.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to elucidate the biological functions, clinical relevance, and regulatory mechanism of long non-coding RNA (lncRNA) ZNF667-AS1 in hepatitis B virus (HBV)-related hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC).
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study enrolled 107 patients with HBV-related HCC, 105 patients with chronic hepatitis B (CHB), and 105 healthy controls to investigate lncRNA ZNF667-AS1 expression and its clinical associations.
analysis.methods: RT-qPCR was used to quantify ZNF667-AS1, miR-210-3p, and CPEB2 expression levels. Bioinformatics prediction and dual-luciferase reporter assays validated the targeted interactions between ZNF667-AS1 and miR-210-3p, and between miR-210-3p and CPEB2. CCK-8 and Transwell assays assessed HCC cell proliferation, migration, and invasion after transfection.
analysis.main_results: ZNF667-AS1 and CPEB2 were significantly downregulated in HBV-related HCC tissues and HBV-associated HCC cell lines. ROC curve analysis showed an AUC of 0.841 for ZNF667-AS1 in distinguishing HBV-related HCC from CHB.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpret that lncRNA ZNF667-AS1 acts as a tumor suppressor in HBV-related HCC by sponging miR-210-3p to upregulate CPEB2, providing a potential auxiliary diagnostic biomarker and a novel regulatory axis for disease pathogenesis.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings suggest that ZNF667-AS1 could serve as a diagnostic biomarker for HBV-related HCC and highlight a potential therapeutic target within the ZNF667-AS1/miR-210-3p/CPEB2 axis.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited by its reliance on in vitro assays and a single-center cohort, which constrains generalizability and causal inference; the evidence strength is assessed as moderate.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigated the role of lncRNA ZNF667-AS1 in HBV-related hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) by enrolling 107 HBV-HCC patients, 105 chronic hepatitis B (CHB) patients, and 105 healthy controls. Using RT-qPCR, dual-luciferase reporter assays, and functional cell assays, the authors demonstrated that ZNF667-AS1 is downregulated in HBV-HCC tissues and cell lines and exerts tumor-suppressive effects by targeting miR-210-3p to upregulate CPEB2. ROC analysis showed an AUC of 0.841 for ZNF667-AS1 in distinguishing HBV-HCC from CHB, supporting its potential as an auxiliary diagnostic biomarker. The study interprets ZNF667-AS1 as a novel regulatory axis in HBV-HCC pathogenesis and suggests therapeutic implications, though limitations include in vitro focus and single-center design, warranting moderate confidence.
